records.name: Arc
records.title: Arc
records.description: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is a benchmark designed to measure human-like general fluid intelligence through grid-based reasoning tasks. It consists of 800 tasks (400 training, 400 evaluation) where each task presents input-output grids that require understanding abstract patterns and transformations. Test-takers must produce exactly correct output grids for all test inputs in a task to solve it, with 3 trials allowed per test input. ARC aims to enable fair comparisons of general intelligence between AI systems and humans using priors designed to be as close as possible to innate human priors.

records.name: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard
records.title: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard
records.description: The Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) is the first comprehensive and executable function call evaluation dedicated to assessing Large Language Models' ability to invoke functions. It evaluates serial and parallel function calls across multiple programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript, REST API) using a novel Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) evaluation method. The benchmark consists of over 2,000 question-function-answer pairs covering diverse application domains and complex use cases including multiple function calls, parallel function calls, and multi-turn interactions.

records.name: BIG-Bench Extra Hard
records.title: BIG-Bench Extra Hard
records.description: BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) is a challenging benchmark that replaces each task in BIG-Bench Hard with a novel task that probes similar reasoning capabilities but exhibits significantly increased difficulty. The benchmark contains 23 tasks testing diverse reasoning skills including many-hop reasoning, causal understanding, spatial reasoning, temporal arithmetic, geometric reasoning, linguistic reasoning, logic puzzles, and humor understanding. Designed to address saturation on existing benchmarks where state-of-the-art models achieve near-perfect scores, BBEH shows substantial room for improvement with best models achieving only 9.8-44.8% average accuracy.

records.name: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
records.title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration

records.name: CoinVE-Bench
records.title: CoinVE-Bench

records.name: ColdDDI
records.title: ColdDDI

records.name: CollabBench
records.title: CollabBench
records.description: Evaluates collaborative ability of LLM agents in cooperative game environments with diverse player profiles and proactive engagement.
records.oneLine: Evaluates collaborative ability of LLM agents in cooperative game environments with diverse player profiles and proactive engagement.

records.name: Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark
records.title: Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark
records.description: Evaluates AI agents as teammates across 240 tasks spanning 8 teamwork dimensions, with programmatically verifiable outcomes and capability-adjusted scoring.
records.oneLine: Evaluates AI agents as teammates across 240 tasks spanning 8 teamwork dimensions, with programmatically verifiable outcomes and capability-adjusted scoring.
records.forecastReason: Novel focus on collaborative intelligence, large task set, and evaluation of 18 models are likely to attract attention from the multi-agent AI community.

records.name: COLLIE
records.title: COLLIE
records.description: COLLIE is a grammar-based framework for systematic construction of constrained text generation tasks. It allows specification of rich, compositional constraints across diverse generation levels and modeling challenges including language understanding, logical reasoning, and semantic planning. The COLLIE-v1 dataset contains 2,080 instances across 13 constraint structures.
records.oneLine: COLLIE is a grammar-based framework for systematic construction of constrained text generation tasks. It allows specification of rich, compositional constraints across diverse generation levels and modeling challenges including language understanding, logical reasoning, and semantic planning. The COLLIE-v1 dataset contains 2,080 instances across 13 constraint structures.

records.name: Colosseum V2
records.title: Colosseum V2
records.description: Simulation benchmark for VLA generalization with 28 tasks across 13 categories and two robot morphologies, using ManiSkill.
records.oneLine: Simulation benchmark for VLA generalization with 28 tasks across 13 categories and two robot morphologies, using ManiSkill.

records.name: ComBench
records.title: ComBench
records.description: ComBench evaluates large language models on 100 human-annotated Olympiad-level combinatorics problems, split into 50 analysis-centric and 50 construction-centric tasks. Scoring combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic verification of construction outputs.
records.oneLine: ComBench evaluates large language models on 100 human-annotated Olympiad-level combinatorics problems, split into 50 analysis-centric and 50 construction-centric tasks. Scoring combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic verification of construction outputs.

records.name: CombEval
records.title: CombEval
records.description: CombEval evaluates combinatorial counting abilities of large language models using problems generated from typed Cofola specifications, with solver-verified answers. It supports systematic variation of object types, entity scales, constraint counts, and reasoning depth.
records.oneLine: CombEval evaluates combinatorial counting abilities of large language models using problems generated from typed Cofola specifications, with solver-verified answers. It supports systematic variation of object types, entity scales, constraint counts, and reasoning depth.

records.name: ComboShoppingBench
records.title: ComboShoppingBench
records.description: ComboShoppingBench is a benchmark for agentic basket shopping with coupons, evaluating LLM agents on constructing feasible baskets with budget and coupon constraints in a simulated environment.
records.oneLine: ComboShoppingBench is a benchmark for agentic basket shopping with coupons, evaluating LLM agents on constructing feasible baskets with budget and coupon constraints in a simulated environment.

records.name: CoMedBench
records.title: CoMedBench
records.description: CoMedBench evaluates synthetic medical data fidelity and downstream utility across 37 dataset-task pairs from seven public sources, using a common clinical-validity framework and shared training and evaluation engine.
records.oneLine: CoMedBench evaluates synthetic medical data fidelity and downstream utility across 37 dataset-task pairs from seven public sources, using a common clinical-validity framework and shared training and evaluation engine.

records.name: CoMemBench
records.title: CoMemBench
records.description: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated.
records.oneLine: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated.

records.name: CoMET-Bench
records.title: CoMET-Bench
records.description: CoMET-Bench is a benchmark for conditional multi-event temporal grounding in long-form video, with 2,789 queries over 600 videos and a unified evaluation protocol including counting, grounding, and negative-query recognition.
records.oneLine: CoMET-Bench is a benchmark for conditional multi-event temporal grounding in long-form video, with 2,789 queries over 600 videos and a unified evaluation protocol including counting, grounding, and negative-query recognition.

records.name: COMEX
records.title: COMEX
records.description: COMEX is a benchmark for explainable aesthetic image cropping containing 33,161 quadruples of expanded image, crop box, composition category, and composition-grounded explanation. It supports joint evaluation of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation.
records.oneLine: COMEX is a benchmark for explainable aesthetic image cropping containing 33,161 quadruples of expanded image, crop box, composition category, and composition-grounded explanation. It supports joint evaluation of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation.

records.name: Common Voice 15
records.title: Common Voice 15
records.description: Common Voice is a massively-multilingual collection of transcribed speech intended for speech technology research and development. Version 15.0 contains 28,750 recorded hours across 114 languages, consisting of crowdsourced voice recordings with corresponding transcriptions.
records.oneLine: Common Voice is a massively-multilingual collection of transcribed speech intended for speech technology research and development. Version 15.0 contains 28,750 recorded hours across 114 languages, consisting of crowdsourced voice recordings with corresponding transcriptions.

records.name: CommonSenseQA
records.title: CommonSenseQA
records.description: CommonSenseQA is a multiple-choice question answering dataset that requires different types of commonsense knowledge to predict correct answers. It contains 12,102 questions with one correct answer and four distractors, designed to test semantic reasoning and conceptual relationships. Questions are created based on ConceptNet concepts and require prior world knowledge for accurate reasoning.
records.oneLine: CommonSenseQA is a multiple-choice question answering dataset that requires different types of commonsense knowledge to predict correct answers. It contains 12,102 questions with one correct answer and four distractors, designed to test semantic reasoning and conceptual relationships. records.name: CommunityFact
records.title: CommunityFact
records.description: CommunityFact evaluates misinformation detection on 15,992 claims across five languages and two domains, using accuracy against human Community Notes ratings as the scoring metric.
records.oneLine: CommunityFact evaluates misinformation detection on 15,992 claims across five languages and two domains, using accuracy against human Community Notes ratings as the scoring metric.

records.name: Compact-Bench
records.title: Compact-Bench
records.description: Compact-Bench measures the cost of context compaction for long-horizon coding agents across three tracks: task preservation, recurring-detail retention, and production-chain retention, using 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 agentic sessions, and 106 production chains.
records.oneLine: Compact-Bench measures the cost of context compaction for long-horizon coding agents across three tracks: task preservation, recurring-detail retention, and production-chain retention, using 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 agentic sessions, and 106 production chains.
records.forecastReason: Context compaction is a pressing issue for coding agents, and the ready-to-run code and dataset likely attract developers and researchers quickly.

records.name: CompanionBench
records.title: CompanionBench
records.description: CompanionBench is an interactive bilingual benchmark for AI emotional companionship, grounding scenarios and a user simulator in de-identified real-world data. It evaluates ten capabilities derived from 25 theories, using a rubric and deterministic disclosure measure.
records.oneLine: CompanionBench is an interactive bilingual benchmark for AI emotional companionship, grounding scenarios and a user simulator in de-identified real-world data. It evaluates ten capabilities derived from 25 theories, using a rubric and deterministic disclosure measure.

records.name: Company Agent Bench
records.title: Company Agent Bench
records.description: Concept's benchmark of how well an AI agent understands the company it works in. Agents answer 205 questions drawn from one month of Concept's own Slack history: who wrote a message, who was tagged and who sent each reply. The score is overall accuracy.
records.oneLine: Concept's benchmark of how well an AI agent understands the company it works in. Agents answer 205 questions drawn from one month of Concept's own Slack history: who wrote a message, who was tagged and who sent each reply. The score is overall accuracy.

records.name: compilebench
records.title: compilebench
records.description: Quesma's CompileBench hands an agent the unmodified source of an open-source project such as curl, jq or GNU coreutils and asks for a working binary. Tasks include static and musl builds, cross-compiling to Windows and ARM64, and reviving code from 2003.
records.oneLine: Quesma's CompileBench hands an agent the unmodified source of an open-source project such as curl, jq or GNU coreutils and asks for a working binary. Tasks include static and musl builds, cross-compiling to Windows and ARM64, and reviving code from 2003.

records.name: ComplexConstraints
records.title: ComplexConstraints
records.description: An instruction-following benchmark from Surge AI that tests whether a model satisfies many simultaneous, interacting constraints in one response.
records.oneLine: An instruction-following benchmark from Surge AI that tests whether a model satisfies many simultaneous, interacting constraints in one response.

records.name: ComplexFuncBench
records.title: ComplexFuncBench
records.description: ComplexFuncBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' capabilities in handling complex function calling scenarios. It encompasses multi-step and constrained function calling tasks that require long-parameter filling, parameter value reasoning, and managing contexts up to 128k tokens. The benchmark includes 1,000 samples across five real-world scenarios.
records.oneLine: ComplexFuncBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' capabilities in handling complex function calling scenarios. records.name: ComplexityWorld
records.title: ComplexityWorld
records.description: ComplexityWorld is a benchmark of 390 visual decision-making tasks across 39 worlds, scored by an executable verifier. It evaluates VLMs on tasks requiring global constraint satisfaction.
records.oneLine: ComplexityWorld is a benchmark of 390 visual decision-making tasks across 39 worlds, scored by an executable verifier. It evaluates VLMs on tasks requiring global constraint satisfaction.

records.name: CompoSET
records.title: CompoSET
records.description: CompoSET evaluates vision-language compositionality using image-text pairs that differ by a single controlled edit, with multiple caption verbosity tiers and 1,776 instances.
records.oneLine: CompoSET evaluates vision-language compositionality using image-text pairs that differ by a single controlled edit, with multiple caption verbosity tiers and 1,776 instances.
records.forecastReason: The controlled single-edit design addresses a recognized flaw in VLM evaluation and includes released data and code, likely attracting attention from vision-language researchers.

records.name: CompSkillBench
records.title: CompSkillBench
records.description: CompSkillBench evaluates compositional skill routing for LLM agents: given a user query and a library of 2,209 real MCP server skills across 24 categories, systems must decompose the query into sub-tasks, retrieve a skill per sub-task, and produce an executable plan. Scoring uses step-level category recall and decomposition accuracy.
records.oneLine: CompSkillBench evaluates compositional skill routing for LLM agents: given a user query and a library of 2,209 real MCP server skills across 24 categories, systems must decompose the query into sub-tasks, retrieve a skill per sub-task, and produce an executable plan. records.name: compute-bazaar-bench
records.title: compute-bazaar-bench
records.description: A benchmark for evaluating agents on compute-market tasks.
records.oneLine: A benchmark for evaluating agents on compute-market tasks.

records.name: ConceptEdit-Bench
records.title: ConceptEdit-Bench
records.description: A granular evaluation suite for image editing across over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts, designed to diagnose model capabilities across real-world scenarios.
records.oneLine: A granular evaluation suite for image editing across over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts, designed to diagnose model capabilities across real-world scenarios.

records.name: Conceptual Reasoning
records.title: Conceptual Reasoning

records.oneLine: Tests whether model judgments rank argumentative critiques in the same order as expert human ratings across philosophy, AI alignment, and other concept-heavy texts.

records.name: CondVLN
records.title: CondVLN
records.description: CondVLN evaluates vision-language navigation agents on 11,500 generated conditional instructions across four simulators, using standard VLN metrics plus Branch Selection Accuracy and Conditional Success Rate.
records.oneLine: CondVLN evaluates vision-language navigation agents on 11,500 generated conditional instructions across four simulators, using standard VLN metrics plus Branch Selection Accuracy and Conditional Success Rate.

records.name: ConfBench
records.title: ConfBench
records.description: ConfBench is a calibration-specific benchmark for key information extraction from documents. It applies 20 degradation pipelines to create 1,346 variants and over 70K entity-level evaluations, spanning the accuracy spectrum for evaluating confidence estimates of VLMs.
records.oneLine: ConfBench is a calibration-specific benchmark for key information extraction from documents. It applies 20 degradation pipelines to create 1,346 variants and over 70K entity-level evaluations, spanning the accuracy spectrum for evaluating confidence estimates of VLMs.

records.name: ConfidenceBench
records.title: ConfidenceBench
records.description: A calibration benchmark evaluating verbalized confidence estimates in frontier LLMs using Brier scores across 200 multiple-choice questions in four categories. Scores are elicited via prompting without logits, applicable to closed and open models.
records.oneLine: A calibration benchmark evaluating verbalized confidence estimates in frontier LLMs using Brier scores across 200 multiple-choice questions in four categories. Scores are elicited via prompting without logits, applicable to closed and open models.

records.name: ConflictBench
records.title: ConflictBench

records.oneLine: ConflictBench is a benchmark with ConflictScore metric to quantify how well models acknowledge conflicting evidence in grounding documents, decomposing responses into claims and labeling them against documents.

records.name: ConlangBench
records.title: ConlangBench
records.description: ConlangBench evaluates large language models on translation and vocabulary learning across 21 constructed languages, with a corpus of over 21 million conlang-English parallel sentence pairs and 321K vocabulary entries. The benchmark includes bidirectional translation tasks and learning-curve analysis for models trained on eight conlangs with sufficient parallel data.
records.oneLine: ConlangBench evaluates large language models on translation and vocabulary learning across 21 constructed languages, with a corpus of over 21 million conlang-English parallel sentence pairs and 321K vocabulary entries. records.name: Connectors

records.oneLine: OpenAI’s prompt-injection robustness evaluation tests whether malicious instructions embedded in connector tool outputs can override system, developer or user instructions. It is a safety evaluation, not ordinary connector task success.

records.name: ContactWorld
records.title: ContactWorld

records.oneLine: ContactWorld is a benchmark and empirical study for vision-tactile world models in contact-rich manipulation, spanning 12 tasks including insertion and screwing, evaluating planning success rates.

records.name: ContextBench
records.title: ContextBench

records.oneLine: Evaluates text-to-image models on 92 roles and 1,656 controlled prompts across context-free, related, and unrelated conditions, measuring bias persistence in visual attributes through metrics like Bias Intensity and Context Consistency Score.

records.name: ContextEcho
records.title: ContextEcho

records.oneLine: Evaluates continual learning in LLM-based systems across six expert-validated domains with stateful tasks sharing learnable latent structure.

records.name: Continual Learning Exam

records.oneLine: Evaluates LLM agents on 600 levels across 89 professional roles, organized as five-level ladders where agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with submissions scored by an evaluation agent against human-authored rubrics.

records.name: ContinuityBench

records.oneLine: ContinuityBench evaluates stateful failover in multi-provider LLM routing. records.name: ConVBench
records.title: ConVBench
records.description: ConVBench is a vision-centric reasoning benchmark where each image is paired with two logically equivalent questions across six categories (action/state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal/intent, commonsense, temporal perception), with metrics for logical consistency and robust accuracy.
records.oneLine: ConVBench is a vision-centric reasoning benchmark where each image is paired with two logically equivalent questions across six categories (action/state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal/intent, commonsense, temporal perception), with metrics for logical consistency and robust accuracy.

records.title: LongHorizonBench Revision 15 — Availability-Ranked 20
records.description: A separate public release of the revision-15 availability-ranked 20-task subset. The selected task environments preserve their original approximately 729–730-day daily market-data windows. Public score-only evaluation rows now include each saved baseline plus up to four saved supplemental repeats for five models; no new provider calls were made for publication. Three models have complete 100/100 recorded attempt rows; DeepSeek and Kimi have partial histories with explicit error and not-started counts. Execution traces and agent outputs remain private. This v3 dataset is separate from the earlier 100-task LongHorizonBench dataset.

records.name: MuSR

records.name: SP-TransientBench
records.title: SP-TransientBench
records.description: SP-TransientBench (STB) is a real-captured multi-task benchmark for single-photon perception. It comprises 10 diverse scenes and 10,297 views captured with a solid-state single-photon LiDAR at 256×192 resolution, providing full time-of-flight histograms with multi-return behavior, calibrated camera poses, and standardized metadata. The benchmark evaluates depth estimation, multi-view reconstruction, and 3D semantic understanding, with 13-class semantic annotations for selected scenes. Dedicated data splits and evaluation protocols are provided for each task.

radarRecords.name: GameXpert-Bench

radarRecords.name: FIRM-Video-Bench

radarRecords.name: VGI-BENCH

radarRecords.name: SWE-bench Science

radarRecords.name: RuleMaze

radarRecords.name: WSE-bench
radarRecords.title: WSE-bench

radarRecords.name: VARM-Bench

radarRecords.name: RigidBench
radarRecords.title: RigidBench

radarRecords.title: PLSQLBench

radarRecords.name: CrossView
radarRecords.title: CrossView
radarRecords.description: CrossView is a multi-camera video question-answering benchmark spanning autonomous driving, security surveillance, egocentric/exocentric video, and robotics. radarRecords.name: WeSCE
radarRecords.title: WeSCE
radarRecords.description: WeSCE is a benchmark for quantifying security drift in LLM-driven code editing. The benchmark proposes a continuous risk representation and drift measures that capture changes in overall risk, worst-case severity, and vulnerability distribution.

radarRecords.name: NumerosityVLM
radarRecords.title: NumerosityVLM
radarRecords.description: Evaluates zero-shot numerosity perception in vision-language models on 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions manipulating object size, spatial arrangement, and numerosity while ablating texture, shape, and color.

radarRecords.name: LongRCA Bench
radarRecords.title: LongRCA Bench
radarRecords.description: LongRCA Bench is a benchmark for diagnosing responsible roles and root causes in long-horizon agent failures. Evaluation focuses on responsible-role accuracy and exact root-step accuracy.

radarRecords.name: LongDocBench
radarRecords.title: LongDocBench
radarRecords.description: LongDocBench is a benchmark for Table-of-Contents Hierarchy Recovery and Contextual Relationship Recovery in long documents. radarRecords.name: FloodReasonBench
radarRecords.title: FloodReasonBench
radarRecords.description: FloodReasonBench is a benchmark for vision-language model reasoning segmentation in flood response scenarios. It also measures accuracy, latency, energy, and communication tradeoffs on an embedded platform.

radarRecords.name: FinFraudBench
radarRecords.title: FinFraudBench
radarRecords.description: FinFraudBench is a heterogeneous graph benchmark for financial fraud detection. It contains two datasets (CreditCard-Fraud and BankTrans-Fraud) with up to 8.99M nodes and 89.23M directed typed edges, preserving six financial entity types and fourteen edge types. The evaluation protocol covers ranking and imbalance-sensitive classification metrics.

radarRecords.name: CBX-Bench
radarRecords.title: CBX-Bench
radarRecords.description: CBX-Bench is a benchmark for quantitatively measuring the quality of Concept Bottleneck Model (CBM) explanations. The benchmark maintains a leaderboard for CBM explanation quality.

radarRecords.oneLine: TradeVerse evaluates LLMs on longitudinal political trade negotiation understanding using reconstructed minutes of 1170 WTO meetings across 5 groups and 89 product groups, with three tasks: predicting HS codes, identifying responding countries, and generating final statements.

radarRecords.name: TAU-Bench
radarRecords.title: TAU-Bench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates anomaly instance tracking and fine-grained anomaly understanding jointly on 1,118 videos with track-centric annotations.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates anomaly instance tracking and fine-grained anomaly understanding jointly on 1,118 videos with track-centric annotations.
radarRecords.forecastReason: The video anomaly understanding scope and track-centric evaluation are likely to attract attention from VLM and video understanding researchers.

radarRecords.name: StreamArena
radarRecords.title: StreamArena
radarRecords.description: StreamArena evaluates hour-scale streaming video understanding across 243 full-length videos (avg 88.8 min) with 3,646 open-ended QA pairs, covering real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool use. Includes a standardized runner and LLM-as-judge scorer.
radarRecords.oneLine: StreamArena evaluates hour-scale streaming video understanding across 243 full-length videos (avg 88.8 min) with 3,646 open-ended QA pairs, covering real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool use. radarRecords.name: StepJack
radarRecords.title: StepJack
radarRecords.description: StepJack evaluates computer-use agents against multi-step indirect prompt injection attacks, where adversarial goals are decomposed into innocuous sub-steps across a chain of pages. It comprises 480 test examples across platforms and instruction types, with attack success rate as the primary metric.
radarRecords.oneLine: StepJack evaluates computer-use agents against multi-step indirect prompt injection attacks, where adversarial goals are decomposed into innocuous sub-steps across a chain of pages. It comprises 480 test examples across platforms and instruction types, with attack success rate as the primary metric.

radarRecords.name: SkillTV-Bench
radarRecords.title: SkillTV-Bench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates whether a judge can verify long-horizon agent executions using original instructions, normalized trajectories, task-time skills, and inspectable artifacts in a runnable environment.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates whether a judge can verify long-horizon agent executions using original instructions, normalized trajectories, task-time skills, and inspectable artifacts in a runnable environment.
radarRecords.forecastReason: The benchmark addresses agentic evaluation with released code and data, a clear scoring protocol, and a proposed skill evolution method that may draw interest from the agent LLM community.

radarRecords.name: OmniMech
radarRecords.title: OmniMech
radarRecords.description: OmniMech evaluates vision-language models on four tasks: CAD program synthesis from engineering drawings, diagram-to-3D reasoning, annotation-grounded reasoning, and tool-augmented agentic reasoning using industrial mechanical data with 251k drawings and associated CAD models.
radarRecords.oneLine: OmniMech evaluates vision-language models on four tasks: CAD program synthesis from engineering drawings, diagram-to-3D reasoning, annotation-grounded reasoning, and tool-augmented agentic reasoning using industrial mechanical data with 251k drawings and associated CAD models.

radarRecords.name: M$^3$R-Bench
radarRecords.title: M$^3$R-Bench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates unified metaphor understanding across 1,000 image-text instances with annotations for occurrence, Target-Source mapping, sentiment, and stage-wise explanations.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates unified metaphor understanding across 1,000 image-text instances with annotations for occurrence, Target-Source mapping, sentiment, and stage-wise explanations.
radarRecords.forecastReason: The benchmark targets multimodal reasoning with a released dataset and code, and the paper reports results against frontier models, likely attracting NLP and vision-language researchers.

radarRecords.name: LangChoiceBench
radarRecords.title: LangChoiceBench
radarRecords.description: LangChoiceBench measures Python preference in project-level code generation across 28 projects and seven software areas, assessing language choice, recommendation-implementation consistency, and language diversity.
radarRecords.oneLine: LangChoiceBench measures Python preference in project-level code generation across 28 projects and seven software areas, assessing language choice, recommendation-implementation consistency, and language diversity.

radarRecords.name: InvestLogicBench
radarRecords.title: InvestLogicBench
radarRecords.description: InvestLogicBench evaluates large language models on personalized investment decision-making using 201,247 documented decisions from 151 real-world investors. Each episode traces investor profile, market events, reasoning, decision, and outcome. Tasks include comprehension, profile-conditioned generation, and end-to-end replay.
radarRecords.oneLine: InvestLogicBench evaluates large language models on personalized investment decision-making using 201,247 documented decisions from 151 real-world investors. Each episode traces investor profile, market events, reasoning, decision, and outcome. Tasks include comprehension, profile-conditioned generation, and end-to-end replay.

radarRecords.name: HarnessOpt-Bench
radarRecords.title: HarnessOpt-Bench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates LLMs optimizing a target agent's harness (prompts, tools, control flow) under budgeted, stochastic evaluation. Scoring is normalized gain over seed on a held-out test partition, with trusted execution environment enforcing evaluation boundary.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates LLMs optimizing a target agent's harness (prompts, tools, control flow) under budgeted, stochastic evaluation. Scoring is normalized gain over seed on a held-out test partition, with trusted execution environment enforcing evaluation boundary.

radarRecords.name: GST-Bench
radarRecords.title: GST-Bench
radarRecords.description: GST-Bench is a VQA benchmark for global spatial intelligence in video understanding, covering synthetic videos and human-verified questions. It evaluates VLMs' ability to infer spatial relations from novel viewpoints and map egocentric observations to top-down views.
radarRecords.oneLine: GST-Bench is a VQA benchmark for global spatial intelligence in video understanding, covering synthetic videos and human-verified questions. It evaluates VLMs' ability to infer spatial relations from novel viewpoints and map egocentric observations to top-down views.

radarRecords.name: GAUGE
radarRecords.title: GAUGE
radarRecords.description: GAUGE evaluates physical fidelity of simulation engines and video world models using 22 task families covering rigid bodies, cables, textiles, and deformable objects, with real-world trajectories and calibrated metadata.
radarRecords.oneLine: GAUGE evaluates physical fidelity of simulation engines and video world models using 22 task families covering rigid bodies, cables, textiles, and deformable objects, with real-world trajectories and calibrated metadata.

radarRecords.name: FinEvo-Bench
radarRecords.title: FinEvo-Bench
radarRecords.description: FinEvo-Bench evaluates self-evolving agents on 120 real-case-grounded tasks across 20 business scenes in six financial domains, with institution-provided procedures and rubrics for quality and compliance.
radarRecords.oneLine: FinEvo-Bench evaluates self-evolving agents on 120 real-case-grounded tasks across 20 business scenes in six financial domains, with institution-provided procedures and rubrics for quality and compliance.

radarRecords.name: EpiBench
radarRecords.title: EpiBench
radarRecords.description: EpiBench evaluates LLMs' epitope reasoning from antibody and antigen sequences across five tasks: targetable region discovery, epitope identification, binning, functional assessment, and escape assessment.
radarRecords.oneLine: EpiBench evaluates LLMs' epitope reasoning from antibody and antigen sequences across five tasks: targetable region discovery, epitope identification, binning, functional assessment, and escape assessment.

radarRecords.name: EcoAgent-Bench
radarRecords.title: EcoAgent-Bench
radarRecords.description: EcoAgent-Bench evaluates LLM agents' economic decision-making under budget constraints across 304 tasks in five families, with priced actions and metrics for micro accuracy and economic consistency.
radarRecords.oneLine: EcoAgent-Bench evaluates LLM agents' economic decision-making under budget constraints across 304 tasks in five families, with priced actions and metrics for micro accuracy and economic consistency.

radarRecords.name: BFI-Adapt
radarRecords.title: BFI-Adapt
radarRecords.description: Evaluates directional fidelity of event-induced personality change in LLM agents across 11 major life events, scored against Big Five trait directions from human longitudinal evidence.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates directional fidelity of event-induced personality change in LLM agents across 11 major life events, scored against Big Five trait directions from human longitudinal evidence.

radarRecords.name: C-SUITEBENCH
radarRecords.title: C-SUITEBENCH
radarRecords.description: C-SUITEBENCH evaluates multimodal LLMs as CEOs on five decision tasks under paired text-only and multimodal conditions across 50 scenarios, focusing on evidence-centric reasoning and constraint satisfaction.
radarRecords.oneLine: C-SUITEBENCH evaluates multimodal LLMs as CEOs on five decision tasks under paired text-only and multimodal conditions across 50 scenarios, focusing on evidence-centric reasoning and constraint satisfaction.

radarRecords.name: GB/T-Bench
radarRecords.title: GB/T-Bench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates LLM capability for rule-intensive review of Chinese GB/T national standard documents, including error location, dimension, and type identification across 25 diagnostic error types.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates LLM capability for rule-intensive review of Chinese GB/T national standard documents, including error location, dimension, and type identification across 25 diagnostic error types.
radarRecords.forecastReason: The benchmark targets a niche but high-stakes domain and includes a new multi-agent framework, which may draw attention from researchers working on document-intensive LLM applications.

radarRecords.name: VA-EvoBench
radarRecords.title: VA-EvoBench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates long-form video understanding agents across eight video distributions with separate evolution and held-out splits.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates long-form video understanding agents across eight video distributions with separate evolution and held-out splits.
radarRecords.forecastReason: Addresses long-form video understanding with automated agent evolution and includes a released benchmark, likely attracting moderate attention.

radarRecords.name: HERA
radarRecords.title: HERA
radarRecords.description: HERA evaluates retrieval-augmented generation for Modern Greek across legal, energy, financial, and medical specialist domains using mined corpora and expert-judged answers.
radarRecords.oneLine: HERA evaluates retrieval-augmented generation for Modern Greek across legal, energy, financial, and medical specialist domains using mined corpora and expert-judged answers.
radarRecords.forecastReason: A first large-scale benchmark for Greek RAG in multiple specialist domains, with released models and broad applicability within NLP communities, supports moderate attention.

radarRecords.name: Skill-Use
radarRecords.title: Skill-Use
radarRecords.description: Skill-Use evaluates skill use in agentic harnesses through 79 real skills and 177 executable tasks across nine domains, measuring trigger, compliance, and boundary adherence with a combined SU score.
radarRecords.oneLine: Skill-Use evaluates skill use in agentic harnesses through 79 real skills and 177 executable tasks across nine domains, measuring trigger, compliance, and boundary adherence with a combined SU score.

radarRecords.name: SearchAuditBench
radarRecords.title: SearchAuditBench

radarRecords.oneLine: SearchAuditBench evaluates LLM auditors on localizing, attributing, and repairing failures in long-horizon search agent trajectories using expert-annotated error steps, root causes, and repair rubrics.
radarRecords.forecastReason: Auditing long-horizon search agents is a niche but timely problem; the benchmark's scale and expert annotations may draw interest from agent evaluation researchers.

radarRecords.name: RESPClinBench
radarRecords.title: RESPClinBench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates clinical decision-making in respiratory specialty care using 623 multimodal cases, including AECOPD-PIM with 427 open-ended COPD cases and PNBIM with 196 pulmonary nodule cases that combine chest CT with clinical information.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates clinical decision-making in respiratory specialty care using 623 multimodal cases, including AECOPD-PIM with 427 open-ended COPD cases and PNBIM with 196 pulmonary nodule cases that combine chest CT with clinical information.

radarRecords.name: RepoProbe
radarRecords.title: RepoProbe
radarRecords.description: Evaluates repository-level code understanding via 500 open-ended questions derived from GitHub Discussions across 50 repositories, scored with checklist-based verification for factual correctness and clarity.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates repository-level code understanding via 500 open-ended questions derived from GitHub Discussions across 50 repositories, scored with checklist-based verification for factual correctness and clarity.

publication.venue: 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)

radarRecords.name: OmniRouting
radarRecords.title: OmniRouting
radarRecords.description: OmniRouting evaluates LLMs on PCB routing reasoning under real-world constraints with 1,681 industrial designs across four tasks: geometric routing, design-rule-aware routing, electrical functionality, and tool-augmented agentic routing.
radarRecords.oneLine: OmniRouting evaluates LLMs on PCB routing reasoning under real-world constraints with 1,681 industrial designs across four tasks: geometric routing, design-rule-aware routing, electrical functionality, and tool-augmented agentic routing.

radarRecords.name: OmniEdit-Bench
radarRecords.title: OmniEdit-Bench

radarRecords.name: NOLLI
radarRecords.title: NOLLI
radarRecords.description: NOLLI is a procedurally generated English-Korean puzzle benchmark with 15 puzzle types (25 tasks, 7,500 items). radarRecords.name: MirageBench
radarRecords.title: MirageBench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates LLM personalization faithfulness: 150 personas, 6 tasks, four-way faithfulness taxonomy, 12 models across 7 families, 143,616 judged claims.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates LLM personalization faithfulness: 150 personas, 6 tasks, four-way faithfulness taxonomy, 12 models across 7 families, 143,616 judged claims.
radarRecords.forecastReason: A counterintuitive self-monitoring finding in a hot personalization safety topic should attract moderate attention despite a narrow evaluation scope.

radarRecords.name: LUNAR
radarRecords.title: LUNAR

radarRecords.oneLine: LUNAR is a benchmark for evaluating LLM personalization from longitudinal app interaction logs across domains like clothing, food, housing, and mobility. It uses a synthetic data pipeline and evaluates 19 LLMs.

radarRecords.name: IslamicTurathBench
radarRecords.title: IslamicTurathBench

radarRecords.name: FinReportBench
radarRecords.title: FinReportBench
radarRecords.description: FinReportBench evaluates institution-grade financial report generation using 244 bilingual tasks sourced from 10,000 financial research records. It uses a 35-item rubric covering deliverability, report identity, and institutional completeness, with three judge families.
radarRecords.oneLine: FinReportBench evaluates institution-grade financial report generation using 244 bilingual tasks sourced from 10,000 financial research records. It uses a 35-item rubric covering deliverability, report identity, and institutional completeness, with three judge families.

radarRecords.name: EuroExec
radarRecords.title: EuroExec

radarRecords.oneLine: EuroExec is an expert-authored benchmark of 413 open-ended European executive tasks evaluated by human experts. It uses a multi-attribute rubric and preference ranking to compute a Solve Rate.

radarRecords.name: EgoAfford
radarRecords.title: EgoAfford

radarRecords.oneLine: EgoAfford is a benchmark for egocentric referring segmentation with task-oriented affordance grounding, comprising 15.5k images and 102 real images. It includes EgoLens, a 3B MLLM reference model.

radarRecords.name: ContextWeave
radarRecords.title: ContextWeave

radarRecords.oneLine: ContextWeave is a longitudinal benchmark for evaluating memory in office workflows, with 1,005 executable tasks from 14 participants. It measures workspace quality and preference alignment.

radarRecords.name: ComplexityWorld
radarRecords.title: ComplexityWorld

radarRecords.oneLine: ComplexityWorld is a benchmark of 390 visual decision-making tasks across 39 worlds, scored by an executable verifier. It evaluates VLMs on tasks requiring global constraint satisfaction.

radarRecords.name: CLIP-CC-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: CLIP-CC-Bench evaluates paragraph-level video description quality using 5-hour movie content and expert-written references. It scores 17 VLMs via coarse- and fine-grained semantic matching with five LLM-based embedding judges.

radarRecords.name: Active-SWE

radarRecords.oneLine: Active-SWE evaluates coding agents on proactive bug fixing: detecting and fixing multiple bugs without issue reports. It includes 1,663 tasks across six bug categories and eight languages, with stages for recorded bugs, potential bugs, and judge validation.

radarRecords.name: WeClawArena
radarRecords.title: WeClawArena

radarRecords.name: VIBE

radarRecords.name: SocietyBench

radarRecords.name: SIGNPOST-Bench

radarRecords.name: SeGaBench

radarRecords.oneLine: SeGaBench is an executable benchmark containing 120 cases (100 synthetic, 20 source-backed) to test whether LLMs can recover semantic optimization opportunities that compilers miss, with hidden enabling semantics, oracle artifacts, and validators.

radarRecords.name: PAST-Bench

radarRecords.name: ParamBench

radarRecords.name: MT-Web2Code

radarRecords.oneLine: LDU-Bench evaluates multimodal LLMs on lithography defect understanding through four tasks: defect triage, morphology recognition, coarse localization, and image-conditioned cause analysis, using task-level metrics and the Lithography Closure Score.

radarRecords.name: GDPevo

radarRecords.name: FinVerse

radarRecords.name: DataSpace
radarRecords.title: DataSpace
radarRecords.description: DataSpace evaluates data agents on analytical questions over heterogeneous workspaces containing CSV, JSON, SQLite, Markdown, PDF, and video artifacts. Agents must discover and integrate relevant evidence and return complete tabular results, scored by a deterministic evaluator using header-invariant column alignment and type-aware comparison.
radarRecords.oneLine: DataSpace evaluates data agents on analytical questions over heterogeneous workspaces containing CSV, JSON, SQLite, Markdown, PDF, and video artifacts. Agents must discover and integrate relevant evidence and return complete tabular results, scored by a deterministic evaluator using header-invariant column alignment and type-aware comparison.

radarRecords.name: ConlangBench
radarRecords.title: ConlangBench
radarRecords.description: ConlangBench evaluates large language models on translation and vocabulary learning across 21 constructed languages, with a corpus of over 21 million conlang-English parallel sentence pairs and 321K vocabulary entries. The benchmark includes bidirectional translation tasks and learning-curve analysis for models trained on eight conlangs with sufficient parallel data.
radarRecords.oneLine: ConlangBench evaluates large language models on translation and vocabulary learning across 21 constructed languages, with a corpus of over 21 million conlang-English parallel sentence pairs and 321K vocabulary entries. The benchmark includes bidirectional translation tasks and learning-curve analysis for models trained on eight conlangs with sufficient parallel data.

radarRecords.name: COMEX
radarRecords.title: COMEX
radarRecords.description: COMEX is a benchmark for explainable aesthetic image cropping containing 33,161 quadruples of expanded image, crop box, composition category, and composition-grounded explanation. It supports joint evaluation of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation.
radarRecords.oneLine: COMEX is a benchmark for explainable aesthetic image cropping containing 33,161 quadruples of expanded image, crop box, composition category, and composition-grounded explanation. It supports joint evaluation of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation.

radarRecords.name: CodeAssay
radarRecords.title: CodeAssay
radarRecords.description: CodeAssay is a benchmark of 185 Python tasks across ten software-engineering categories with audited ground truth, public and hidden tests, and code-property measures. It evaluates LLM code generation correctness and other code properties.
radarRecords.oneLine: CodeAssay is a benchmark of 185 Python tasks across ten software-engineering categories with audited ground truth, public and hidden tests, and code-property measures. It evaluates LLM code generation correctness and other code properties.

radarRecords.name: ChartAnno
radarRecords.title: ChartAnno
radarRecords.description: ChartAnno is a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on chart annotation generation with 1,200 real-world charts and paired code/instructions. It evaluates annotation quality under different instruction specificity and input settings.
radarRecords.oneLine: ChartAnno is a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on chart annotation generation with 1,200 real-world charts and paired code/instructions. It evaluates annotation quality under different instruction specificity and input settings.

radarRecords.name: CARE-Bench
radarRecords.title: CARE-Bench
radarRecords.description: CARE-Bench is a source-grounded benchmark for patient-facing triage evaluation with 500 cases and 1,059 patient-disclosure prefixes. It evaluates LLMs on a four-label current-action task across 269 held-out rounds.
radarRecords.oneLine: CARE-Bench is a source-grounded benchmark for patient-facing triage evaluation with 500 cases and 1,059 patient-disclosure prefixes. It evaluates LLMs on a four-label current-action task across 269 held-out rounds.

radarRecords.name: BrainBench
radarRecords.title: BrainBench
radarRecords.description: BrainBench is a benchmark for instruction-conditioned EEG understanding covering four subsets across 17 datasets. It evaluates LLMs on producing scientific reports and artifacts from EEG recordings.
radarRecords.oneLine: BrainBench is a benchmark for instruction-conditioned EEG understanding covering four subsets across 17 datasets. It evaluates LLMs on producing scientific reports and artifacts from EEG recordings.

radarRecords.name: BanglaWild
radarRecords.title: BanglaWild
radarRecords.description: BanglaWild is a benchmark of 2,535 Bengali scene text images with verbatim gold transcriptions and diagnostic attributes. It evaluates OCR and vision-language models on in-the-wild scene text recognition.
radarRecords.oneLine: BanglaWild is a benchmark of 2,535 Bengali scene text images with verbatim gold transcriptions and diagnostic attributes. It evaluates OCR and vision-language models on in-the-wild scene text recognition.

radarRecords.name: ArtECulture
radarRecords.title: ArtECulture
radarRecords.description: ArtECulture is a benchmark for culture-conditioned visual emotion understanding with 6,792 artworks and culture-specific labels across three cultures. It evaluates MLLMs on predicting cultural emotion perception and explaining rationale.
radarRecords.oneLine: ArtECulture is a benchmark for culture-conditioned visual emotion understanding with 6,792 artworks and culture-specific labels across three cultures. It evaluates MLLMs on predicting cultural emotion perception and explaining rationale.

radarRecords.name: AntiSkillBench
radarRecords.title: AntiSkillBench
radarRecords.description: AntiSkillBench is a benchmark for evaluating privacy leakage and impersonation risks in persona-skills. It includes 7,500 persona-grounded dialogue traces and evaluates across three skill-distillation strategies.
radarRecords.oneLine: AntiSkillBench is a benchmark for evaluating privacy leakage and impersonation risks in persona-skills. It includes 7,500 persona-grounded dialogue traces and evaluates across three skill-distillation strategies.

radarRecords.name: AI Security Leaderboard
radarRecords.title: AI Security Leaderboard
radarRecords.description: The AI Security Leaderboard evaluates frontier AI model safeguards against the FAR.AI Minimal Standard for Safeguards across severe misuse requests (CBRNE threats and offensive cybersecurity), testing for universal jailbreaks.
radarRecords.oneLine: The AI Security Leaderboard evaluates frontier AI model safeguards against the FAR.AI Minimal Standard for Safeguards across severe misuse requests (CBRNE threats and offensive cybersecurity), testing for universal jailbreaks.

radarRecords.name: AGENTCHAOSBENCH
radarRecords.title: AGENTCHAOSBENCH
radarRecords.description: AGENTCHAOSBENCH is a dataset of sanitized execution traces from five agentic applications with injected runtime faults, used to evaluate fault detection and localization from telemetry.
radarRecords.oneLine: AGENTCHAOSBENCH is a dataset of sanitized execution traces from five agentic applications with injected runtime faults, used to evaluate fault detection and localization from telemetry.

radarRecords.name: WorldExam
radarRecords.title: WorldExam
radarRecords.description: WorldExam evaluates controllable video generation models as world models across four levels: Visual Quality, Control Adherence, Spatial Consistency, and World Reactivity, with 1,474 cases across eight tasks.
radarRecords.oneLine: WorldExam evaluates controllable video generation models as world models across four levels: Visual Quality, Control Adherence, Spatial Consistency, and World Reactivity, with 1,474 cases across eight tasks.

radarRecords.name: UAV3DCrop
radarRecords.title: UAV3DCrop
radarRecords.description: UAV3DCrop is a benchmark of repeated multi-angle UAV crop surveys with 88,830 images across 91 scenes, evaluating 3D reconstruction methods on appearance, geometry, and canopy height.
radarRecords.oneLine: UAV3DCrop is a benchmark of repeated multi-angle UAV crop surveys with 88,830 images across 91 scenes, evaluating 3D reconstruction methods on appearance, geometry, and canopy height.

radarRecords.name: SVGEval
radarRecords.title: SVGEval
radarRecords.description: SVGEval is a vision-grounded benchmark for human-aligned SVG quality assessment, with multi-round labeled annotations, evaluating models on semantic, aesthetic, geometry, and layout judgments.
radarRecords.oneLine: SVGEval is a vision-grounded benchmark for human-aligned SVG quality assessment, with multi-round labeled annotations, evaluating models on semantic, aesthetic, geometry, and layout judgments.

radarRecords.name: SPIKE-Bench
radarRecords.title: SPIKE-Bench
radarRecords.description: SPIKE-Bench evaluates LLM biosecurity risks using 631 curated toxin-design prompts and a three-stage funnel (compliance, plausibility, predicted toxicity) producing the Functional Harmfulness Rate.
radarRecords.oneLine: SPIKE-Bench evaluates LLM biosecurity risks using 631 curated toxin-design prompts and a three-stage funnel (compliance, plausibility, predicted toxicity) producing the Functional Harmfulness Rate.

radarRecords.name: ScrambleToolBench
radarRecords.title: ScrambleToolBench
radarRecords.description: ScrambleToolBench evaluates agent behavioral reasoning in an interactive terminal environment with obfuscated tools and dynamic challenges like mapping drift and stochastic failures.
radarRecords.oneLine: ScrambleToolBench evaluates agent behavioral reasoning in an interactive terminal environment with obfuscated tools and dynamic challenges like mapping drift and stochastic failures.

radarRecords.name: SciStyleBench
radarRecords.title: SciStyleBench
radarRecords.description: SciStyleBench diagnoses stylistic bias in LLM-based idea evaluation through controlled stylistic perturbations, metrics, and a mitigation extractor.
radarRecords.oneLine: SciStyleBench diagnoses stylistic bias in LLM-based idea evaluation through controlled stylistic perturbations, metrics, and a mitigation extractor.

radarRecords.name: PRWeaver
radarRecords.title: PRWeaver
radarRecords.description: PRWeaver evaluates LLM-based code auditors against malicious pull requests across repository history, using 208 attacks and multiple renderings.
radarRecords.oneLine: PRWeaver evaluates LLM-based code auditors against malicious pull requests across repository history, using 208 attacks and multiple renderings.

radarRecords.name: PredAct-Bench
radarRecords.title: PredAct-Bench
radarRecords.description: PredAct-Bench evaluates dialogue agents paired with imperfect tools using educational datasets, measuring AI-assisted decision-making and trust metrics.
radarRecords.oneLine: PredAct-Bench evaluates dialogue agents paired with imperfect tools using educational datasets, measuring AI-assisted decision-making and trust metrics.

radarRecords.name: onepot-Bench
radarRecords.title: onepot-Bench
radarRecords.description: onepot-Bench 0 is a proprietary benchmark suite evaluating language models on synthetic chemistry capabilities, including cheminformatics literacy, safety behavior, and reaction outcome prediction.
radarRecords.oneLine: onepot-Bench 0 is a proprietary benchmark suite evaluating language models on synthetic chemistry capabilities, including cheminformatics literacy, safety behavior, and reaction outcome prediction.

radarRecords.name: MedPRESS
radarRecords.title: MedPRESS
radarRecords.description: MedPRESS evaluates LLM sycophancy in multi-turn medical dialogues, containing 600 five-turn scenarios across three families with structured judging and safety metrics.
radarRecords.oneLine: MedPRESS evaluates LLM sycophancy in multi-turn medical dialogues, containing 600 five-turn scenarios across three families with structured judging and safety metrics.

radarRecords.name: II-Bench
radarRecords.title: II-Bench
radarRecords.description: II-Bench evaluates computer-use agents against low-harm adversarial tasks across three platforms, with 444 examples and a testing framework.
radarRecords.oneLine: II-Bench evaluates computer-use agents against low-harm adversarial tasks across three platforms, with 444 examples and a testing framework.

radarRecords.name: IBA-Bench
radarRecords.title: IBA-Bench
radarRecords.description: IBA-Bench evaluates LLM agents on implicit behavioral alignment using longitudinal interaction histories, across nine application domains.
radarRecords.oneLine: IBA-Bench evaluates LLM agents on implicit behavioral alignment using longitudinal interaction histories, across nine application domains.

radarRecords.name: GISAgentBench
radarRecords.title: GISAgentBench
radarRecords.description: GISAgentBench evaluates LLM agents on multi-step GIS tasks from practitioner sources, with 349 tasks and executable reference trajectories.
radarRecords.oneLine: GISAgentBench evaluates LLM agents on multi-step GIS tasks from practitioner sources, with 349 tasks and executable reference trajectories.

radarRecords.name: GEOID-Flood
radarRecords.title: GEOID-Flood
radarRecords.description: GEOID-Flood is a large-scale multi-modal benchmark for flood segmentation with over 14,000 tiles, co-registered SAR and optical data, and validated labels.

radarRecords.name: GABench
radarRecords.title: GABench
radarRecords.description: GABench evaluates LLM agents on graph analysis tasks across three graph types and four task categories: graph retrieval, graph theory, graph machine learning, and graph open-ended QA. It provides 84 executable tools and 10,400 tasks with verifiable ground truth.
radarRecords.oneLine: GABench evaluates LLM agents on graph analysis tasks across three graph types and four task categories: graph retrieval, graph theory, graph machine learning, and graph open-ended QA. It provides 84 executable tools and 10,400 tasks with verifiable ground truth.

radarRecords.name: Event ActivityNet
radarRecords.title: Event ActivityNet
radarRecords.description: Event ActivityNet is a large-scale simulated-event benchmark for untrimmed action understanding, derived from ActivityNet videos. It includes 3,263 videos, 200 action classes, event-voxel representations, temporal annotations, and supports recognition, event-language alignment, and online temporal localization.

radarRecords.name: CultureVidBench
radarRecords.title: CultureVidBench
radarRecords.description: CultureVidBench evaluates cultural understanding in text-to-video generation with 1,000 curated prompts covering 12 countries, 6 continents, and 14 cultural aspects. It assesses cultural faithfulness, multimodal cultural rendering, semantic adherence, and perceptual quality using human studies and MLLM-based automatic assessment.
radarRecords.oneLine: CultureVidBench evaluates cultural understanding in text-to-video generation with 1,000 curated prompts covering 12 countries, 6 continents, and 14 cultural aspects. radarRecords.name: ConfBench
radarRecords.title: ConfBench
radarRecords.description: ConfBench is a calibration-specific benchmark for key information extraction from documents. It applies 20 degradation pipelines to create 1,346 variants and over 70K entity-level evaluations, spanning the accuracy spectrum for evaluating confidence estimates of VLMs.
radarRecords.oneLine: ConfBench is a calibration-specific benchmark for key information extraction from documents. It applies 20 degradation pipelines to create 1,346 variants and over 70K entity-level evaluations, spanning the accuracy spectrum for evaluating confidence estimates of VLMs.

radarRecords.name: CompanionBench
radarRecords.title: CompanionBench
radarRecords.description: CompanionBench is an interactive bilingual benchmark for AI emotional companionship, grounding scenarios and a user simulator in de-identified real-world data. It evaluates ten capabilities derived from 25 theories, using a rubric and deterministic disclosure measure.
radarRecords.oneLine: CompanionBench is an interactive bilingual benchmark for AI emotional companionship, grounding scenarios and a user simulator in de-identified real-world data. It evaluates ten capabilities derived from 25 theories, using a rubric and deterministic disclosure measure.

radarRecords.name: BulkPR-Bench
radarRecords.title: BulkPR-Bench
radarRecords.description: BulkPR-Bench evaluates governance of interacting pull requests. It includes 581 candidate PRs on 18 repositories, with metrics RDS and Global-SGY measuring safe delivery. The benchmark uses executable repository execution with hidden safety checks.
radarRecords.oneLine: BulkPR-Bench evaluates governance of interacting pull requests. It includes 581 candidate PRs on 18 repositories, with metrics RDS and Global-SGY measuring safe delivery. The benchmark uses executable repository execution with hidden safety checks.

radarRecords.name: AuthMem-Bench
radarRecords.title: AuthMem-Bench
radarRecords.description: AuthMem-Bench evaluates authority collapse in persistent memory for LLM agents. It uses a paired benchmark holding claims and tasks fixed while varying source authority, measuring write-time collapse, authorization errors, and automatic authority preservation.
radarRecords.oneLine: AuthMem-Bench evaluates authority collapse in persistent memory for LLM agents. It uses a paired benchmark holding claims and tasks fixed while varying source authority, measuring write-time collapse, authorization errors, and automatic authority preservation.

radarRecords.name: SCHEDBench
radarRecords.title: SCHEDBench
radarRecords.description: SCHEDBench evaluates LLM constraint faithfulness in natural-language combinatorial scheduling. It includes 1,132 instances across JSP, RCPSP, nurse rostering, and timetabling, with templated NL variations and solver-verified references.
radarRecords.oneLine: SCHEDBench evaluates LLM constraint faithfulness in natural-language combinatorial scheduling. It includes 1,132 instances across JSP, RCPSP, nurse rostering, and timetabling, with templated NL variations and solver-verified references.

radarRecords.name: MasDrift
radarRecords.title: MasDrift
radarRecords.description: Evaluates multi-agent systems on 600 productivity tasks measuring task completion and unauthorized action rate across different coordination architectures.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates multi-agent systems on 600 productivity tasks measuring task completion and unauthorized action rate across different coordination architectures.

radarRecords.name: Lethe
radarRecords.title: Lethe
radarRecords.description: Lethe is a benchmark for federated unlearning in medical imaging. It evaluates twelve methods across eight task families, including classification, segmentation, denoising, cross-modality synthesis, and vision-language question answering. Three forgetting granularities (hospital, class, patient) are assessed against a retrained gold standard on utility, privacy, and cost.

It evaluates twelve methods across eight task families, including classification, segmentation, denoising, cross-modality synthesis, and vision-language question answering. radarRecords.name: HopRefusalBench
radarRecords.title: HopRefusalBench
radarRecords.description: HopRefusalBench evaluates refusal behavior of search-augmented language model agents on multi-hop questions that are unanswerable, covering three causes of unanswerability and three chain topologies.
radarRecords.oneLine: HopRefusalBench evaluates refusal behavior of search-augmented language model agents on multi-hop questions that are unanswerable, covering three causes of unanswerability and three chain topologies.

radarRecords.name: DunphyBench
radarRecords.title: DunphyBench
radarRecords.description: DunphyBench evaluates long-horizon embodied decision-making in housing environments, requiring agents to navigate and choose options aligned with multi-dimensional human preferences under partial observations.
radarRecords.oneLine: DunphyBench evaluates long-horizon embodied decision-making in housing environments, requiring agents to navigate and choose options aligned with multi-dimensional human preferences under partial observations.

radarRecords.name: Doc2CI
radarRecords.title: Doc2CI

radarRecords.oneLine: DOC2CI evaluates LLM-generated CI/CD configuration YAML against reference configurations from four CI services, measuring exact match and schema validity.

radarRecords.name: Boundary-Bench
radarRecords.title: Boundary-Bench
radarRecords.description: Boundary-Bench is an open-source plugin that adds configurable security policy levels to Terminal-Bench, enabling evaluation of coding agents under constraints like scoped credentials, restricted egress, read-only filesystems, and non-root execution.
radarRecords.oneLine: Boundary-Bench is an open-source plugin that adds configurable security policy levels to Terminal-Bench, enabling evaluation of coding agents under constraints like scoped credentials, restricted egress, read-only filesystems, and non-root execution.

radarRecords.name: Vul4Py
radarRecords.title: Vul4Py
radarRecords.description: Vul4Py evaluates automated vulnerability repair in Python across 100 real vulnerabilities from 60 open-source projects, with paired exploit and functional oracles.
radarRecords.oneLine: Vul4Py evaluates automated vulnerability repair in Python across 100 real vulnerabilities from 60 open-source projects, with paired exploit and functional oracles.

radarRecords.name: TreeProbe
radarRecords.title: TreeProbe
radarRecords.description: TreeProbe is a dataset of 4,719 expert-adjudicated items covering 467 diseases and 10 subtasks across the Tibetan Tree of Medicine framework, used to evaluate cultural bias in LLMs.
radarRecords.oneLine: TreeProbe is a dataset of 4,719 expert-adjudicated items covering 467 diseases and 10 subtasks across the Tibetan Tree of Medicine framework, used to evaluate cultural bias in LLMs.

radarRecords.name: S2M-Bench
radarRecords.title: S2M-Bench
radarRecords.description: S2M-Bench evaluates the task of reconstructing mind maps from lecture slides, comprising 12,774 slide pages from 24 university courses with expert-annotated mind maps. The evaluation framework integrates ground-truth comparison, structure conformity analysis, and VLM-as-a-Judge scoring.

radarRecords.name: FinDeepIndicator
radarRecords.title: FinDeepIndicator
radarRecords.description: FinDeepIndicator evaluates deep research agents on end-to-end financial indicator construction across four stages: formula specification, data collection, indicator calculation, and answer generation. It includes 3,350 QA pairs from U.S. and Chinese markets, 10 years of historical data, and 800 listed companies.

radarRecords.name: EduPluginBench
radarRecords.title: EduPluginBench
radarRecords.description: EduPluginBench is an executable benchmark for evaluating code-generation models on producing plugins that meet governed ecosystem requirements including least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, and bounded failure. It uses 1,440 mutants and 120 clean references with staged admission levels P0-P4.

radarRecords.name: AdvPlan-Bench
radarRecords.title: AdvPlan-Bench
radarRecords.description: AdvPlan-Bench is an offline benchmark for adversarial evaluation of structured plan-generation agents. It uses typed action chains, adversarial response sets, selector diagnostics, and metrics like BLUE-vs-RED advantage and Nash-gap. Includes 150 synthetic scenarios across five planning templates.

radarRecords.name: SciFigPlag-Bench
radarRecords.title: SciFigPlag-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: SciFigPlag-Bench evaluates provenance-aware reasoning for scientific figure plagiarism detection. It includes 2,582 positive and 2,541 negative pairs, with tasks for pairwise detection, source attribution, reuse-type classification, and reuse correspondence localization.

radarRecords.name: MMShopBench
radarRecords.title: MMShopBench
radarRecords.description: MMShopBench is a real-log benchmark for multimodal multi-turn shopping agents. It uses cleaned shopping logs with annotations for purchase intent and mandatory product requirements. Agents must infer requirements from images and dialogue, retrieve candidates, and verify product satisfaction.
radarRecords.oneLine: MMShopBench is a real-log benchmark for multimodal multi-turn shopping agents. radarRecords.name: MirrorCraft
radarRecords.title: MirrorCraft
radarRecords.description: MirrorCraft is a paired benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents under hidden rule changes in Minecraft. It includes five biomes, six rule suites, three objectives, and uses deterministic milestones and Rule Intervention Effect.

radarRecords.name: MetaRoute-Bench
radarRecords.title: MetaRoute-Bench
radarRecords.description: MetaRoute-Bench is an open framework for comparing meta-decision policies in agentic workflow routing. radarRecords.oneLine: MetaRoute-Bench is an open framework for comparing meta-decision policies in agentic workflow routing. radarRecords.name: MDArena
radarRecords.title: MDArena
radarRecords.description: MDArena evaluates coding agents on 50 containerized molecular dynamics tasks from active research projects, covering trajectory analysis, system preparation, free-energy protocols, and enhanced sampling, with strict pass-based scoring.
radarRecords.oneLine: MDArena evaluates coding agents on 50 containerized molecular dynamics tasks from active research projects, covering trajectory analysis, system preparation, free-energy protocols, and enhanced sampling, with strict pass-based scoring.

radarRecords.name: M3-DuplexBench
radarRecords.title: M3-DuplexBench

radarRecords.oneLine: M3-DuplexBench evaluates full-duplex spoken dialogue models in multi-turn, multilingual (English and Japanese), multidomain settings, with multiple dialogue context settings and turn-taking analysis.

radarRecords.name: LoopsBench
radarRecords.title: LoopsBench

radarRecords.oneLine: LOOPSBENCH evaluates coding agents on long-horizon tasks structured as dependency DAGs with flow-aware test release and regression obligations, spanning 8 languages and 9 domains.

radarRecords.name: LiveCodeBench
radarRecords.title: LiveCodeBench

radarRecords.name: InfraBench
radarRecords.title: InfraBench

radarRecords.oneLine: InfraBench evaluates AI agents on realistic infrastructure tasks across the system stack and lifecycle, with fine-grained per-check risk assessment and a public leaderboard.

radarRecords.name: Hy-MultiTurn
radarRecords.title: Hy-MultiTurn

radarRecords.name: FriendBench
radarRecords.title: FriendBench

radarRecords.oneLine: FriendBench evaluates dyadic familiarity inference in humans and models using 96 dyads, comparing accuracy across modalities.

radarRecords.name: ExtractBench
radarRecords.title: ExtractBench
radarRecords.description: ExtractBench evaluates schema-guided extraction from enterprise documents. Given a document and a user-defined JSON schema, systems must return schema-valid JSON with correct values, include every record of repeated structures, mark missing fields as null, and provide source evidence. The benchmark includes 4,869 pages across 370 documents, 8 business domains, and 67 document types, with tags for challenge, perception, table structure, length, and domain. Scoring uses unified value F1 for value accuracy and word- and page-level F1 for grounding.

radarRecords.name: DungeonBench
radarRecords.title: DungeonBench

radarRecords.oneLine: DungeonBench evaluates tactical reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons combat with two tracks: Encounter for single fights and Day for linked encounters with persistent resources, using a shared decision stream of complete tactical observations and legal options.

radarRecords.name: AgentHPOBench
radarRecords.title: AgentHPOBench
radarRecords.description: AgentHPOBench evaluates LLM agents as sequential hyperparameter optimizers across 30 executable ML tasks. Agents observe accumulated configurations, metrics, and logs, then propose the next configuration. Scoring compares agents and conventional HPO baselines under a unified protocol.
radarRecords.oneLine: AgentHPOBench evaluates LLM agents as sequential hyperparameter optimizers across 30 executable ML tasks. Agents observe accumulated configurations, metrics, and logs, then propose the next configuration. Scoring compares agents and conventional HPO baselines under a unified protocol.

radarRecords.name: RepBench
radarRecords.title: RepBench
radarRecords.description: RepBench compiles 353 public benchmarks into 46,149 probe texts spanning 94 capabilities, with a taxonomy of 182 clusters in 13 families. radarRecords.name: PerceptionBench

radarRecords.oneLine: PerceptionBench evaluates atomic visual perception in MLLMs with 3,000 verified questions isolating ten perceptual capabilities, based on an error taxonomy from 42 benchmarks.

radarRecords.name: LU-500
radarRecords.title: LU-500

radarRecords.oneLine: LU-500 evaluates concept unlearning for logos with nearly 10,000 pairs, including explicit and implicit contextual tracks, and a multi-grained protocol measuring local removal and global preservation.

radarRecords.name: INS-ActBench
radarRecords.title: INS-ActBench

radarRecords.oneLine: INS-ActBench evaluates actuarial capability in LLMs across knowledge, case reasoning, and tool-based practice with 12,050 tasks from public exams.

radarRecords.name: GraphRareBench
radarRecords.title: GraphRareBench

radarRecords.oneLine: GraphRareBench evaluates phenotype-driven rare-disease ranking with 2,365 cases, 18,093 target-confounder pairs, and auditable evidence records.

radarRecords.name: GAUGE
radarRecords.title: GAUGE
radarRecords.description: GAUGE evaluates agent-built financial valuation models against observed analyst practice using 56 facets, eight validity gates, and a failure-aware score over 196 tasks.
radarRecords.oneLine: GAUGE evaluates agent-built financial valuation models against observed analyst practice using 56 facets, eight validity gates, and a failure-aware score over 196 tasks.

radarRecords.name: FilmBench
radarRecords.title: FilmBench
radarRecords.description: FilmBench evaluates text-to-video and reference-to-video generation using a Cinematic Language taxonomy with 1,169 prompts and 35 sub-metrics.
radarRecords.oneLine: FilmBench evaluates text-to-video and reference-to-video generation using a Cinematic Language taxonomy with 1,169 prompts and 35 sub-metrics.

radarRecords.name: EXE-Bench
radarRecords.title: EXE-Bench
radarRecords.description: EXE-Bench evaluates AI-based Windows malware detectors on performance, temporal robustness, adversarial robustness, and computational overhead, aggregated into a single score.
radarRecords.oneLine: EXE-Bench evaluates AI-based Windows malware detectors on performance, temporal robustness, adversarial robustness, and computational overhead, aggregated into a single score.

radarRecords.name: ERUnderstand
radarRecords.title: ERUnderstand
radarRecords.description: ERUnderstand evaluates vision-language models on structured understanding of entity-relationship diagrams. The benchmark contains 2,960 diagrams across curated educational sources, real-world schemas, and synthetic data, with standardized machine-readable JSON annotations. Scoring uses F1, BLEU, and graph edit distance to measure how accurately models recover schema elements such as entities, relationships, attributes, and extended ER constructs.
radarRecords.oneLine: ERUnderstand evaluates vision-language models on structured understanding of entity-relationship diagrams. radarRecords.name: DailyBench
radarRecords.title: DailyBench
radarRecords.description: DailyBench is a unified benchmark for evaluating AI-generated image detectors on modern full-image synthesis and object-level manipulation. It comprises FakeBench, with images from recent open-source and commercial generative models, and ManipulationBench, with subtle edits to real images. Detectors are scored by balanced accuracy.

It comprises FakeBench, with images from recent open-source and commercial generative models, and ManipulationBench, with subtle edits to real images. Detectors are scored by balanced accuracy.

radarRecords.name: ArmnetBench
radarRecords.title: ArmnetBench
radarRecords.description: A benchmark for robot manipulation policies evaluated on a fleet of low-cost SO-101 cells. It compares 7 policies across 12 tasks in single-arm and bimanual configurations, with 2,518 policy rollouts and 600 reference demonstrations, all labeled successful, suboptimal, or failure. Data is released in LeRobot and RoboMeter formats.
radarRecords.oneLine: A benchmark for robot manipulation policies evaluated on a fleet of low-cost SO-101 cells.
