radarRecords.name: CloudCons
radarRecords.title: CloudCons
radarRecords.description: CloudCons is an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in cloud resource consolidation. It encompasses datasets from Huawei Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Google Borg with diverse workload patterns, and evaluates statistical, deep learning, and time series foundation models. The evaluation includes resource efficiency and service reliability metrics under a forecast-then-optimize paradigm.
radarRecords.oneLine: CloudCons is an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in cloud resource consolidation. It encompasses datasets from Huawei Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Google Borg with diverse workload patterns, and evaluates statistical, deep learning, and time series foundation models. The evaluation includes resource efficiency and service reliability metrics under a forecast-then-optimize paradigm.

radarRecords.name: AuthorityBench
radarRecords.title: AuthorityBench
radarRecords.description: AuthorityBench evaluates how citation-based authority signals affect epistemic behavior in LLMs using 220,564 prompts across four domains, with a 2x2 factorial design crossing claim veracity and citation veracity.
radarRecords.oneLine: AuthorityBench evaluates how citation-based authority signals affect epistemic behavior in LLMs using 220,564 prompts across four domains, with a 2x2 factorial design crossing claim veracity and citation veracity.

radarRecords.name: Shopping Reasoning Bench
radarRecords.title: Shopping Reasoning Bench
radarRecords.description: Assesses multi-turn conversational shopping assistants across 525 expert-authored missions with importance-weighted binary rubrics. Evaluates reasoning across five categories covering preference refinement, trade-off analysis, and compatibility assessment.
radarRecords.oneLine: Assesses multi-turn conversational shopping assistants across 525 expert-authored missions with importance-weighted binary rubrics. Evaluates reasoning across five categories covering preference refinement, trade-off analysis, and compatibility assessment.

radarRecords.name: SalArt-VQA
radarRecords.title: SalArt-VQA
radarRecords.description: SalArt-VQA is a closed-set visual question answering benchmark for fine-grained salient artifact understanding in AI-generated images. It includes 950 images and 3,681 human-authored multiple-choice questions covering artifact images, matched real references, and paired generated references. Four aligned question types evaluate presence detection, semantic localization, spatial grounding, and evidence-grounded defect identification, with reference splits for calibration and abstention testing.
radarRecords.oneLine: SalArt-VQA is a closed-set visual question answering benchmark for fine-grained salient artifact understanding in AI-generated images. It includes 950 images and 3,681 human-authored multiple-choice questions covering artifact images, matched real references, and paired generated references. Four aligned question types evaluate presence detection, semantic localization, spatial grounding, and evidence-grounded defect identification, with reference splits for calibration and abstention testing.

radarRecords.name: RQ-Bench
radarRecords.title: RQ-Bench
radarRecords.description: RQ-Bench evaluates novelty of research questions generated by LLMs against author-anchored reference questions from recent arXiv papers, using standalone and comparative LLM judging as well as human expert evaluation.
radarRecords.oneLine: RQ-Bench evaluates novelty of research questions generated by LLMs against author-anchored reference questions from recent arXiv papers, using standalone and comparative LLM judging as well as human expert evaluation.

radarRecords.name: MedCTA
radarRecords.title: MedCTA
radarRecords.description: MedCTA evaluates clinical tool agents on 107 clinician-verified, step-implicit tasks with multimodal inputs (radiology images, pathology slides, reports) and 5 deployed tools. Metrics cover tool selection, argument validity, execution stability, trajectory fidelity, and outcome quality.
radarRecords.oneLine: MedCTA evaluates clinical tool agents on 107 clinician-verified, step-implicit tasks with multimodal inputs (radiology images, pathology slides, reports) and 5 deployed tools. Metrics cover tool selection, argument validity, execution stability, trajectory fidelity, and outcome quality.

radarRecords.name: HybridCodeAuthorship
radarRecords.title: HybridCodeAuthorship
radarRecords.description: HybridCodeAuthorship is a benchmark of Python files with interleaved human- and AI-authored lines, built from CodeSearchNet, for developing and evaluating AI-generated code detection algorithms at line- and chunk-level.
radarRecords.oneLine: HybridCodeAuthorship is a benchmark of Python files with interleaved human- and AI-authored lines, built from CodeSearchNet, for developing and evaluating AI-generated code detection algorithms at line- and chunk-level.

radarRecords.name: GraphInfer-Bench
radarRecords.title: GraphInfer-Bench
radarRecords.description: GraphInfer-Bench evaluates LLMs on graph inference tasks where answers reside in no single node or path, covering five task types over six real-world graphs with 42,000 samples. Tasks include masked-node prediction, edge inference, theme description, outlier detection, and community partition.
radarRecords.oneLine: GraphInfer-Bench evaluates LLMs on graph inference tasks where answers reside in no single node or path, covering five task types over six real-world graphs with 42,000 samples. Tasks include masked-node prediction, edge inference, theme description, outlier detection, and community partition.

radarRecords.name: ExtremeWhenBench
radarRecords.title: ExtremeWhenBench
radarRecords.description: ExtremeWhenBench evaluates natural-language temporal grounding in hour-long videos, with 2,273 open-form queries over 194 videos. Metrics include mIoU and R@k for predicted time intervals, with strict parse-failure handling.
radarRecords.oneLine: ExtremeWhenBench evaluates natural-language temporal grounding in hour-long videos, with 2,273 open-form queries over 194 videos. Metrics include mIoU and R@k for predicted time intervals, with strict parse-failure handling.

radarRecords.name: DuoBench
radarRecords.title: DuoBench
radarRecords.description: DuoBench is a benchmarking framework for bimanual manipulation policies on the FR3 Duo platform, with eleven tasks across four coordination categories, simulated and partially real-world, plus human-teleoperated datasets. It proposes stage-based evaluation beyond binary success.
radarRecords.oneLine: DuoBench is a benchmarking framework for bimanual manipulation policies on the FR3 Duo platform, with eleven tasks across four coordination categories, simulated and partially real-world, plus human-teleoperated datasets. It proposes stage-based evaluation beyond binary success.

radarRecords.name: DrugBench
radarRecords.title: DrugBench
radarRecords.description: DrugBench evaluates AI control protocols for mitigating medication-related harm using 3,671 medical conversations and FDA drug labels, covering drug interactions, contraindications, dosing constraints, and patient action restrictions. Introduces severity-based monitoring.
radarRecords.oneLine: DrugBench evaluates AI control protocols for mitigating medication-related harm using 3,671 medical conversations and FDA drug labels, covering drug interactions, contraindications, dosing constraints, and patient action restrictions. Introduces severity-based monitoring.

radarRecords.name: Claw-SWE-Bench
radarRecords.title: Claw-SWE-Bench
radarRecords.description: Claw-SWE-Bench is a multilingual SWE-bench-style benchmark and adapter protocol for comparing agent harnesses on coding tasks, with 350 GitHub issue-resolution instances across 8 languages and 43 repositories. Score is Pass@1 on patch correctness.
radarRecords.oneLine: Claw-SWE-Bench is a multilingual SWE-bench-style benchmark and adapter protocol for comparing agent harnesses on coding tasks, with 350 GitHub issue-resolution instances across 8 languages and 43 repositories. Score is Pass@1 on patch correctness.

radarRecords.name: SciAgentArena
radarRecords.title: SciAgentArena
radarRecords.description: Interactive, agent-agnostic environment with ~200 scientific research tasks evaluated via stepwise verification.
radarRecords.oneLine: Interactive, agent-agnostic environment with ~200 scientific research tasks evaluated via stepwise verification.
radarRecords.forecastReason: Topical focus on AI for science and a public leaderboard may attract moderate initial interest, but the scope is experimental and no adoption evidence is supplied.

radarRecords.name: WorldOlympiad
radarRecords.title: WorldOlympiad
radarRecords.description: WorldOlympiad is a triathlon-style benchmark for video-based world models, evaluating physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity across gaming, robotics, and general real-world scenarios. It includes 1,000 long videos and interpretable automatic metrics.
radarRecords.oneLine: WorldOlympiad is a triathlon-style benchmark for video-based world models, evaluating physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity across gaming, robotics, and general real-world scenarios. It includes 1,000 long videos and interpretable automatic metrics.

radarRecords.name: Workflow-GYM
radarRecords.title: Workflow-GYM
radarRecords.description: Workflow-GYM evaluates AI agents on long-horizon GUI tasks in professional domains, using specialized software environments and economically valuable workflows. Tasks require end-to-end operation of graphical user interfaces, with success rates measured by task completion.
radarRecords.oneLine: Workflow-GYM evaluates AI agents on long-horizon GUI tasks in professional domains, using specialized software environments and economically valuable workflows. Tasks require end-to-end operation of graphical user interfaces, with success rates measured by task completion.

radarRecords.name: UMI-Bench
radarRecords.title: UMI-Bench
radarRecords.description: UMI-Bench 1.0 is a benchmark for tabletop robotic manipulation policies using the Universal Manipulation Interface, with a unified protocol for data collection, reset, execution, and logging.
radarRecords.oneLine: UMI-Bench 1.0 is a benchmark for tabletop robotic manipulation policies using the Universal Manipulation Interface, with a unified protocol for data collection, reset, execution, and logging.

radarRecords.name: T1-Bench
radarRecords.title: T1-Bench
radarRecords.description: T1-Bench evaluates agentic systems through realistic customer-facing, multi-domain tasks. Scenarios involve multi-turn user-assistant interactions across 25 domains with varying difficulty, measuring structured reasoning, tool utilization, and conversational quality. Automatic evaluation is complemented by human judgments.
radarRecords.oneLine: T1-Bench evaluates agentic systems through realistic customer-facing, multi-domain tasks. Scenarios involve multi-turn user-assistant interactions across 25 domains with varying difficulty, measuring structured reasoning, tool utilization, and conversational quality. Automatic evaluation is complemented by human judgments.

radarRecords.name: STAGE-Claw
radarRecords.title: STAGE-Claw
radarRecords.description: STAGE-Claw is an automated framework for building and evaluating personal-agent tasks in state-based computing environments, with a benchmark of 40 tasks. Evaluations measure final system state correctness.
radarRecords.oneLine: STAGE-Claw is an automated framework for building and evaluating personal-agent tasks in state-based computing environments, with a benchmark of 40 tasks. Evaluations measure final system state correctness.

radarRecords.name: SocSci-Repro-Bench
radarRecords.title: SocSci-Repro-Bench
radarRecords.description: SocSci-Repro-Bench evaluates AI coding agents on reproducing social science findings from 221 tasks across four disciplines and 13 domains, using studies with known reproducibility outcomes.
radarRecords.oneLine: SocSci-Repro-Bench evaluates AI coding agents on reproducing social science findings from 221 tasks across four disciplines and 13 domains, using studies with known reproducibility outcomes.

radarRecords.name: SkillResolve-Bench
radarRecords.title: SkillResolve-Bench
radarRecords.description: SkillResolve-Bench 1.0 evaluates agent skill retrieval under same-capability ambiguity, pairing helpful skills with risky siblings. It includes 661 pairs, a 7,982-candidate pool, disjoint splits, and reports Recall@K and harmful sibling rate (HSR@K).
radarRecords.oneLine: SkillResolve-Bench 1.0 evaluates agent skill retrieval under same-capability ambiguity, pairing helpful skills with risky siblings. It includes 661 pairs, a 7,982-candidate pool, disjoint splits, and reports Recall@K and harmful sibling rate (HSR@K).

radarRecords.name: SciConBench
radarRecords.title: SciConBench
radarRecords.description: SciConBench evaluates AI agents on open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis using 9,110 questions and expert-written conclusions from systematic reviews. The evaluation decomposes conclusions into atomic facts and measures correctness and comprehensiveness via factual precision and recall.
radarRecords.oneLine: SciConBench evaluates AI agents on open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis using 9,110 questions and expert-written conclusions from systematic reviews. The evaluation decomposes conclusions into atomic facts and measures correctness and comprehensiveness via factual precision and recall.

radarRecords.name: PhysTool-Bench
radarRecords.title: PhysTool-Bench
radarRecords.description: PhysTool-Bench evaluates multimodal LLMs on physical tool use through two tasks: recognizing all tools in a scene and selecting and sequencing tools for a given task, using 2,510 queries over 2,678 real-world tools.
radarRecords.oneLine: PhysTool-Bench evaluates multimodal LLMs on physical tool use through two tasks: recognizing all tools in a scene and selecting and sequencing tools for a given task, using 2,510 queries over 2,678 real-world tools.

radarRecords.name: PhantomBench
radarRecords.title: PhantomBench
radarRecords.description: PhantomBench evaluates language models' ability to abstain from answering about non-existent entities. It comprises over 60,000 non-existent terms derived from real concepts across domains, and provides a pipeline for generating further instances.
radarRecords.oneLine: PhantomBench evaluates language models' ability to abstain from answering about non-existent entities. It comprises over 60,000 non-existent terms derived from real concepts across domains, and provides a pipeline for generating further instances.

radarRecords.name: P3D-Bench
radarRecords.title: P3D-Bench
radarRecords.description: P3D-Bench evaluates multimodal large language models on parametric 3D generation from text, image, and assembly specifications, scoring executability, geometric fidelity, topology, text-grounded constraints, multiview semantic alignment, and part-level structure.
radarRecords.oneLine: P3D-Bench evaluates multimodal large language models on parametric 3D generation from text, image, and assembly specifications, scoring executability, geometric fidelity, topology, text-grounded constraints, multiview semantic alignment, and part-level structure.

radarRecords.name: OncoTraj
radarRecords.title: OncoTraj
radarRecords.description: OncoTraj is a public benchmark for predicting acquired resistance to first-line osimertinib in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer. It provides a harmonized dataset of 813 patients from three real-world sources, with locked splits, an evaluation harness, and six baselines, defining three tasks: 12-month progression classification, time-to-progression regression, and resistance mechanism classification.
radarRecords.oneLine: OncoTraj is a public benchmark for predicting acquired resistance to first-line osimertinib in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer. It provides a harmonized dataset of 813 patients from three real-world sources, with locked splits, an evaluation harness, and six baselines, defining three tasks: 12-month progression classification, time-to-progression regression, and resistance mechanism classification.

radarRecords.name: MPC-Patch-Bench
radarRecords.title: MPC-Patch-Bench
radarRecords.description: MPC-Patch-Bench evaluates LLM-based code repair on repository-level Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) software. It provides 205 verified instances with Fail-to-Pass/Pass-to-Pass tests and a verifier that checks cryptographic safety and numerical fidelity via differential testing and static analysis.
radarRecords.oneLine: MPC-Patch-Bench evaluates LLM-based code repair on repository-level Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) software. It provides 205 verified instances with Fail-to-Pass/Pass-to-Pass tests and a verifier that checks cryptographic safety and numerical fidelity via differential testing and static analysis.

radarRecords.name: LakeQA
radarRecords.title: LakeQA
radarRecords.description: LakeQA evaluates search-centric question answering over a 9.5 TB data lake of Wikipedia and government data. Tasks require multi-hop reasoning across heterogeneous structured and unstructured sources, with expert-annotated answers.
radarRecords.oneLine: LakeQA evaluates search-centric question answering over a 9.5 TB data lake of Wikipedia and government data. Tasks require multi-hop reasoning across heterogeneous structured and unstructured sources, with expert-annotated answers.

radarRecords.name: Janus
radarRecords.title: Janus
radarRecords.description: JANUS is a benchmark with 160 scenarios across 8 domains, each providing a fixed pool of favorable and adverse facts and paired neutral and goal-directed prompts, to evaluate fact-grounded, goal-conditioned pragmatic distortion in LLM outputs.
radarRecords.oneLine: JANUS is a benchmark with 160 scenarios across 8 domains, each providing a fixed pool of favorable and adverse facts and paired neutral and goal-directed prompts, to evaluate fact-grounded, goal-conditioned pragmatic distortion in LLM outputs.

radarRecords.name: ComBench
radarRecords.title: ComBench
radarRecords.description: ComBench evaluates large language models on 100 human-annotated Olympiad-level combinatorics problems, split into 50 analysis-centric and 50 construction-centric tasks. Scoring combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic verification of construction outputs.
radarRecords.oneLine: ComBench evaluates large language models on 100 human-annotated Olympiad-level combinatorics problems, split into 50 analysis-centric and 50 construction-centric tasks. Scoring combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic verification of construction outputs.

radarRecords.name: CIAware-Bench
radarRecords.title: CIAware-Bench
radarRecords.description: CIAware-Bench measures control intervention awareness in language models through four task domains: essay writing, BigCodeBench, Bash Arena, and SHADE-Arena. Models are tested on distinguishing their own trajectories from those modified by a control protocol, with variations in watermarking, side-task presence, and protocol.
radarRecords.oneLine: CIAware-Bench measures control intervention awareness in language models through four task domains: essay writing, BigCodeBench, Bash Arena, and SHADE-Arena. Models are tested on distinguishing their own trajectories from those modified by a control protocol, with variations in watermarking, side-task presence, and protocol.

radarRecords.name: ABC-Bench
radarRecords.title: ABC-Bench
radarRecords.description: ABC-Bench evaluates LLM agents on biosecurity-relevant tasks including liquid handling robot code generation, DNA fragment design, and DNA synthesis screening evasion, with wet-lab validation.
radarRecords.oneLine: ABC-Bench evaluates LLM agents on biosecurity-relevant tasks including liquid handling robot code generation, DNA fragment design, and DNA synthesis screening evasion, with wet-lab validation.

radarRecords.name: WeaveBench
radarRecords.title: WeaveBench
radarRecords.description: WeaveBench evaluates computer-use agents on 114 long-horizon tasks across 8 real-world work domains. Each task interleaves GUI interaction with command-line and code operations in a single trajectory, with scoring based on a trajectory-aware judge that detects fabricated evidence.
radarRecords.oneLine: WeaveBench evaluates computer-use agents on 114 long-horizon tasks across 8 real-world work domains. Each task interleaves GUI interaction with command-line and code operations in a single trajectory, with scoring based on a trajectory-aware judge that detects fabricated evidence.

radarRecords.name: UXBench
radarRecords.title: UXBench
radarRecords.description: UXBench evaluates user experience in AI assistants through three tasks: UX Judge (binary classification of response quality), UX Eval (response generation), and UX Recovery (repairing failed interactions). The dataset contains 7,400 test instances from 70K+ real interaction logs, covering 8 scenarios and 83 domains. Scoring uses accuracy for Judge and GRM-rated quality for generation tasks.
radarRecords.oneLine: UXBench evaluates user experience in AI assistants through three tasks: UX Judge (binary classification of response quality), UX Eval (response generation), and UX Recovery (repairing failed interactions). The dataset contains 7,400 test instances from 70K+ real interaction logs, covering 8 scenarios and 83 domains. Scoring uses accuracy for Judge and GRM-rated quality for generation tasks.

radarRecords.name: TRL-Bench
radarRecords.title: TRL-Bench
radarRecords.description: TRL-Bench evaluates tabular encoders at the representation level by exporting row-, column-, or table-level embeddings through each encoder's supported wrapper and probing them with shared lightweight heads across three suites: TRL-CTbench (column/table), TRL-Rbench (row), and TRL-DLTE (compositional Data-Lake Table Enrichment) covering 16 tasks and 20 models.
radarRecords.oneLine: TRL-Bench evaluates tabular encoders at the representation level by exporting row-, column-, or table-level embeddings through each encoder's supported wrapper and probing them with shared lightweight heads across three suites: TRL-CTbench (column/table), TRL-Rbench (row), and TRL-DLTE (compositional Data-Lake Table Enrichment) covering 16 tasks and 20 models.

radarRecords.name: TheoremBench
radarRecords.title: TheoremBench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates LLMs on theorem proving in Lean4 using classical theorems, with two versions: main and premised. Includes metrics for theorem-level coverage and token efficiency to assess partial progress and proof structure.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates LLMs on theorem proving in Lean4 using classical theorems, with two versions: main and premised. Includes metrics for theorem-level coverage and token efficiency to assess partial progress and proof structure.

radarRecords.name: TABVERSE
radarRecords.title: TABVERSE
radarRecords.description: TABVERSE is a controlled multimodal benchmark that aligns the same table content across HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, and rendered images, with question category and difficulty tags. It evaluates LLMs and VLMs on question answering, structural understanding, and structure reconstruction.
radarRecords.oneLine: TABVERSE is a controlled multimodal benchmark that aligns the same table content across HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, and rendered images, with question category and difficulty tags. It evaluates LLMs and VLMs on question answering, structural understanding, and structure reconstruction.

radarRecords.name: ST-Bench
radarRecords.title: ST-Bench
radarRecords.description: ST-Bench is a verification benchmark for evaluating certified robustness of spatio-temporal neural networks on autonomous driving (Udacity) and activity recognition (UCF-101) tasks, using spatio-temporal perturbation constraints.
radarRecords.oneLine: ST-Bench is a verification benchmark for evaluating certified robustness of spatio-temporal neural networks on autonomous driving (Udacity) and activity recognition (UCF-101) tasks, using spatio-temporal perturbation constraints.

radarRecords.name: SpatialWorld
radarRecords.title: SpatialWorld
radarRecords.description: SpatialWorld evaluates multimodal agents on interactive spatial reasoning in 760 real-world tasks across eight simulation backends. Agents operate under vision-only partial observability, using a unified text-based action interface. Performance is measured via terminal-state verifiers for task success rate and step efficiency.
radarRecords.oneLine: SpatialWorld evaluates multimodal agents on interactive spatial reasoning in 760 real-world tasks across eight simulation backends. Agents operate under vision-only partial observability, using a unified text-based action interface. Performance is measured via terminal-state verifiers for task success rate and step efficiency.

radarRecords.name: RTL-Bench
radarRecords.title: RTL-Bench
radarRecords.description: RTL-BenchLS evaluates LLMs on RTL design generation and reasoning, containing over 10,000 formally verified Verilog designs. Tasks include specification-to-RTL generation, round-trip reasoning, masked-content reasoning, and repository-issue reasoning. All tasks are verified via formal equivalence checking without manual testbenches.
radarRecords.oneLine: RTL-BenchLS evaluates LLMs on RTL design generation and reasoning, containing over 10,000 formally verified Verilog designs. Tasks include specification-to-RTL generation, round-trip reasoning, masked-content reasoning, and repository-issue reasoning. All tasks are verified via formal equivalence checking without manual testbenches.

radarRecords.name: POPSICLE
radarRecords.title: POPSICLE
radarRecords.description: POPSICLE benchmarks cryoET segmentation and macromolecular localization using data from the CryoET Data Portal. It spans eukaryotic and prokaryotic systems, purified and in situ samples, and covers dense voxel-wise segmentation and sparse localization tasks. Built on the CryoET Data Portal, it can expand with new data.
radarRecords.oneLine: POPSICLE benchmarks cryoET segmentation and macromolecular localization using data from the CryoET Data Portal. It spans eukaryotic and prokaryotic systems, purified and in situ samples, and covers dense voxel-wise segmentation and sparse localization tasks. Built on the CryoET Data Portal, it can expand with new data.

radarRecords.name: OmniGameArena
radarRecords.title: OmniGameArena
radarRecords.description: OmniGameArena evaluates VLM game agents across twelve Unreal Engine 5 games spanning Solo, PvP, and Coop play. It provides unified action interfaces and two evaluation clocks (PDQ for decision quality, LCRT for real-time latency). The Improvement Dynamics Curve (IDC) measures agent improvement through reflection rounds.
radarRecords.oneLine: OmniGameArena evaluates VLM game agents across twelve Unreal Engine 5 games spanning Solo, PvP, and Coop play. It provides unified action interfaces and two evaluation clocks (PDQ for decision quality, LCRT for real-time latency). The Improvement Dynamics Curve (IDC) measures agent improvement through reflection rounds.

radarRecords.name: NormBench
radarRecords.title: NormBench
radarRecords.description: NormBench evaluates defeasible scope parsing in legal texts using Span-Grounded Deontic Trees, with 2,290 provisions across multiple languages. It focuses on identifying clause overrides and includes whole-tree fidelity metrics.
radarRecords.oneLine: NormBench evaluates defeasible scope parsing in legal texts using Span-Grounded Deontic Trees, with 2,290 provisions across multiple languages. It focuses on identifying clause overrides and includes whole-tree fidelity metrics.

radarRecords.name: LexRubric
radarRecords.title: LexRubric
radarRecords.description: LexRubric evaluates open-ended legal tasks in Chinese, with 649 instances from legal consultation and judicial examination. It includes 12,337 expert-written atomic scoring criteria under a six-dimensional framework, enabling fine-grained diagnostic evaluation.
radarRecords.oneLine: LexRubric evaluates open-ended legal tasks in Chinese, with 649 instances from legal consultation and judicial examination. It includes 12,337 expert-written atomic scoring criteria under a six-dimensional framework, enabling fine-grained diagnostic evaluation.

radarRecords.name: iOSWorld
radarRecords.title: iOSWorld
radarRecords.description: iOSWorld evaluates phone agents on interactive tasks within a native iOS simulator. It includes 26 custom iOS apps with connected personal data, 133 tasks across single-app, multi-app, and memory/personalization categories. Agents are evaluated with rubric-based scoring.
radarRecords.oneLine: iOSWorld evaluates phone agents on interactive tasks within a native iOS simulator. It includes 26 custom iOS apps with connected personal data, 133 tasks across single-app, multi-app, and memory/personalization categories. Agents are evaluated with rubric-based scoring.

radarRecords.name: IMUG-Bench
radarRecords.title: IMUG-Bench
radarRecords.description: IMUG-Bench evaluates unified multimodal models on multi-turn interleaved image-text understanding and generation. It includes 3,113 samples and 12,034 interaction turns across Static Spatial, Temporal Causal, and Hybrid classes, with dynamic understanding questions.
radarRecords.oneLine: IMUG-Bench evaluates unified multimodal models on multi-turn interleaved image-text understanding and generation. It includes 3,113 samples and 12,034 interaction turns across Static Spatial, Temporal Causal, and Hybrid classes, with dynamic understanding questions.

radarRecords.name: H2HMem
radarRecords.title: H2HMem
radarRecords.description: H2HMem is a benchmark for evaluating memory capabilities of agents in human-human multimodal interactions, covering dyadic and multi-party conversations with tasks in memory recall, reasoning, and application.
radarRecords.oneLine: H2HMem is a benchmark for evaluating memory capabilities of agents in human-human multimodal interactions, covering dyadic and multi-party conversations with tasks in memory recall, reasoning, and application.

radarRecords.name: ERBench
radarRecords.title: ERBench
radarRecords.description: ERBench is an evaluation framework for equation discovery algorithms, assessing recovery of groundtruth formulas under varying dimensionality, sampling size, distribution, and domain.
radarRecords.oneLine: ERBench is an evaluation framework for equation discovery algorithms, assessing recovery of groundtruth formulas under varying dimensionality, sampling size, distribution, and domain.

radarRecords.name: EgoTactile
radarRecords.title: EgoTactile
radarRecords.description: EgoTactile is a dataset pairing egocentric video with full-hand pressure supervision for everyday objects, including a bare-hand transfer subset.
radarRecords.oneLine: EgoTactile is a dataset pairing egocentric video with full-hand pressure supervision for everyday objects, including a bare-hand transfer subset.

radarRecords.name: Ego-MC-Bench
radarRecords.title: Ego-MC-Bench
radarRecords.description: Ego-MC-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating reactive step-by-step task guidance in cooking scenarios, focusing on timely interventions when mistakes occur.
radarRecords.oneLine: Ego-MC-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating reactive step-by-step task guidance in cooking scenarios, focusing on timely interventions when mistakes occur.

radarRecords.name: Distract-Bench
radarRecords.title: Distract-Bench
radarRecords.description: Distract-Bench evaluates robustness of vision-language models to semantic visual distractions, which are meaningful but task-irrelevant cues that preserve the ground-truth answer.
radarRecords.oneLine: Distract-Bench evaluates robustness of vision-language models to semantic visual distractions, which are meaningful but task-irrelevant cues that preserve the ground-truth answer.

radarRecords.name: ContextShift
radarRecords.title: ContextShift
radarRecords.description: ContextShift is a controlled benchmark that manipulates object-context relationships in COCO images to isolate context as an independent variable for object detection evaluation.
radarRecords.oneLine: ContextShift is a controlled benchmark that manipulates object-context relationships in COCO images to isolate context as an independent variable for object detection evaluation.

radarRecords.name: BenSyc
radarRecords.title: BenSyc
radarRecords.description: BenSyc is a benchmark for studying conversational sycophancy in Bengali social contexts, with binary labels and a five-level taxonomy from invalidation to escalation.
radarRecords.oneLine: BenSyc is a benchmark for studying conversational sycophancy in Bengali social contexts, with binary labels and a five-level taxonomy from invalidation to escalation.

radarRecords.name: ZIPBench
radarRecords.title: ZIPBench
radarRecords.description: ZIPBench is a zero-shot personalization benchmark with 1.5K users, graph-mined personas, and 40K generated images for evaluating text-to-image personalization.
radarRecords.oneLine: ZIPBench is a zero-shot personalization benchmark with 1.5K users, graph-mined personas, and 40K generated images for evaluating text-to-image personalization.

radarRecords.name: PIPE-Cypher
radarRecords.title: PIPE-Cypher
radarRecords.description: PIPE-Cypher is a pipeline that generates NL-to-Cypher benchmarks from live property graphs, producing executable query pairs with validation, diversity controls, and local LLM judges.
radarRecords.oneLine: PIPE-Cypher is a pipeline that generates NL-to-Cypher benchmarks from live property graphs, producing executable query pairs with validation, diversity controls, and local LLM judges.

radarRecords.name: PerspectiveGap
radarRecords.title: PerspectiveGap
radarRecords.description: PerspectiveGap is a benchmark with 110 scenarios for evaluating multi-agent orchestration prompting, using distractor-mixed tasks and topologies from the authors' practice.
radarRecords.oneLine: PerspectiveGap is a benchmark with 110 scenarios for evaluating multi-agent orchestration prompting, using distractor-mixed tasks and topologies from the authors' practice.

radarRecords.name: OmniCap-IF
radarRecords.title: OmniCap-IF
radarRecords.description: OmniCap-IF evaluates instruction following in omni-modal video captioning with 50 constraint types, 1,920 samples, and checklist-based scoring for format and content correctness.
radarRecords.oneLine: OmniCap-IF evaluates instruction following in omni-modal video captioning with 50 constraint types, 1,920 samples, and checklist-based scoring for format and content correctness.

radarRecords.name: LilyBench
radarRecords.title: LilyBench

radarRecords.name: MineXplore
radarRecords.title: MineXplore
radarRecords.description: MineXplore is an open-source MuJoCo-based benchmark for robot navigation in GNSS-denied underground mine environments, derived from the Leung et al. 2017 Chilean copper mine dataset. The benchmark includes an evaluation protocol based on coverage percentage, with a 90% target for single-agent PPO policies.

radarRecords.name: MemoryDocDataSet

radarRecords.description: MemoryDocDataSet evaluates joint conversational memory and long-document reasoning through 50 synthetic micro-worlds, each with personas, temporal event graphs, real legal documents, multi-session conversations, and QA pairs. Questions are categorized by reasoning type, with Hybrid questions requiring navigation of conversation history to locate the relevant document and extract answers.
radarRecords.oneLine: MemoryDocDataSet evaluates joint conversational memory and long-document reasoning through 50 synthetic micro-worlds, each with personas, temporal event graphs, real legal documents, multi-session conversations, and QA pairs. Questions are categorized by reasoning type, with Hybrid questions requiring navigation of conversation history to locate the relevant document and extract answers.

radarRecords.name: LEVANTE-bench
radarRecords.title: LEVANTE-bench
radarRecords.description: LEVANTE-bench evaluates vision-language models on six cognitive tasks from the LEVANTE dataset, comparing model performance and error patterns with children aged 5-12 across three countries.
radarRecords.oneLine: LEVANTE-bench evaluates vision-language models on six cognitive tasks from the LEVANTE dataset, comparing model performance and error patterns with children aged 5-12 across three countries.

radarRecords.name: IntegrityBench
radarRecords.title: IntegrityBench
radarRecords.description: IntegrityBench evaluates language models on research integrity tasks, including misconduct classification, ethical action reasoning, and artifact-grounded decision making, across 36 paired tasks with a 5-level pressure protocol spanning multiple domains and research stages.
radarRecords.oneLine: IntegrityBench evaluates language models on research integrity tasks, including misconduct classification, ethical action reasoning, and artifact-grounded decision making, across 36 paired tasks with a 5-level pressure protocol spanning multiple domains and research stages.

radarRecords.name: GENEB
radarRecords.title: GENEB
radarRecords.description: GENEB evaluates frozen representations from 40 genomic foundation models across 100 DNA classification tasks in 13 functional categories, using a unified linear probing protocol with full-data, 10-shot, and 1-shot regimes. Primary metric is Matthews correlation coefficient, with rankings at overall, category, and task levels.
radarRecords.oneLine: GENEB evaluates frozen representations from 40 genomic foundation models across 100 DNA classification tasks in 13 functional categories, using a unified linear probing protocol with full-data, 10-shot, and 1-shot regimes. radarRecords.name: FinED-Bench
radarRecords.title: FinED-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: FinED-Bench evaluates error detection in financial documents across nine real-world financial scenarios, covering three cognitive complexity levels. It includes over 900 documents from 2025, with data and code publicly available.

radarRecords.name: DeployBench
radarRecords.title: DeployBench
radarRecords.description: DeployBench evaluates LLM agents on 51 research-artifact deployment tasks across AI/ML, systems, and scientific computing. Tasks require setting up environments with multi-language toolchains and system-level dependencies, verified by hidden pipelines that execute the paper's experiments and check outputs.
radarRecords.oneLine: DeployBench evaluates LLM agents on 51 research-artifact deployment tasks across AI/ML, systems, and scientific computing. Tasks require setting up environments with multi-language toolchains and system-level dependencies, verified by hidden pipelines that execute the paper's experiments and check outputs.

radarRecords.name: CyberGym-E2E
radarRecords.title: CyberGym-E2E
radarRecords.description: CyberGym-E2E evaluates AI agents on end-to-end cybersecurity tasks, covering vulnerability discovery, proof-of-concept generation, and patch generation, using 920 real-world vulnerabilities from 139 open-source projects.
radarRecords.oneLine: CyberGym-E2E evaluates AI agents on end-to-end cybersecurity tasks, covering vulnerability discovery, proof-of-concept generation, and patch generation, using 920 real-world vulnerabilities from 139 open-source projects.

radarRecords.name: CRA-Bench
radarRecords.title: CRA-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: A session-layer framework for tracking conversational risk accumulation in multi-turn LLM systems, including CRA-Bench datasets and trajectory-native evaluation protocols.

radarRecords.name: CalorieBench-80K
radarRecords.title: CalorieBench-80K

radarRecords.name: AutoLab
radarRecords.title: AutoLab

radarRecords.oneLine: AutoLab evaluates frontier models on long-horizon closed-loop optimization tasks across system optimization, CUDA kernel optimization, model development, and puzzle challenges, with 36 expert-curated tasks and a strict wall-clock budget.

radarRecords.name: AICompanionBench
radarRecords.title: AICompanionBench

radarRecords.oneLine: AICompanionBench provides a dataset of 2,123 human-AI companion conversations with safety risk annotations to evaluate LLMs-as-judges for detecting unsafe interactions.

radarRecords.name: Agent Planning Benchmark
radarRecords.title: Agent Planning Benchmark

radarRecords.name: VistaHop
radarRecords.title: VistaHop

radarRecords.oneLine: VistaHop is a benchmark for long-horizon Visual DeepSearch, evaluating repeated image inspection, visual-anchor grounding, and evidence traversal across 600 tasks.

radarRecords.name: VidMsg
radarRecords.title: VidMsg

radarRecords.oneLine: VidMsg is a benchmark for implicit message inference in short videos, containing 400 clips across 9 topic areas with retrieval and multiple-choice QA tasks.

radarRecords.name: TurtleAI
radarRecords.title: TurtleAI
radarRecords.description: TurtleAI is a benchmark of 823 tasks for visual programming in Turtle Graphics, evaluating models on perceiving geometric patterns and synthesizing Python code.
radarRecords.oneLine: TurtleAI is a benchmark of 823 tasks for visual programming in Turtle Graphics, evaluating models on perceiving geometric patterns and synthesizing Python code.

radarRecords.name: SynCred-Bench
radarRecords.title: SynCred-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: SynCred-Bench evaluates detection of AI-generated visual misinformation with synthetic credibility, using 600 AI-generated images and FP450 real-image negatives.

radarRecords.name: scTranslation
radarRecords.title: scTranslation
radarRecords.description: scTranslation evaluates single-cell multi-omics modality translation across RNA, ATAC, and ADT modalities, with diverse datasets, six representative models, and comprehensive metrics.
radarRecords.oneLine: scTranslation evaluates single-cell multi-omics modality translation across RNA, ATAC, and ADT modalities, with diverse datasets, six representative models, and comprehensive metrics.

radarRecords.name: SagaQA
radarRecords.title: SagaQA
radarRecords.description: SagaQA is a long-form video benchmark for multi-hop reasoning over full-length TV series, requiring reasoning across episodes and multimodal narrative understanding.
radarRecords.oneLine: SagaQA is a long-form video benchmark for multi-hop reasoning over full-length TV series, requiring reasoning across episodes and multimodal narrative understanding.

radarRecords.name: RUT-Bench
radarRecords.title: RUT-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: RUT-Bench evaluates LLM tool-use in realistic user interactions with 1,638 test samples across 59 executable environments, measuring success rate, informational honesty, and tool discipline.

radarRecords.name: RobotValues
radarRecords.title: RobotValues

radarRecords.oneLine: RobotValues evaluates household robot planners in 10K value-conflict scenarios with realistic images, testing value preferences and action selection under conflicting human values.

radarRecords.name: ReasonMatch-Bench
radarRecords.title: ReasonMatch-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: ReasonMatch-Bench evaluates wide-baseline matching and spatial reasoning in MLLMs, with benchmarks stratified by viewpoint displacement and matching granularity across indoor, outdoor, and object-centric scenarios.

radarRecords.name: PyraMathBench
radarRecords.title: PyraMathBench
radarRecords.description: PyraMathBench is a hierarchical benchmark with 32,505 questions derived from math word problems, evaluating numerical reasoning and mathematical capabilities across cognitive aspects and modalities.
radarRecords.oneLine: PyraMathBench is a hierarchical benchmark with 32,505 questions derived from math word problems, evaluating numerical reasoning and mathematical capabilities across cognitive aspects and modalities.

radarRecords.name: OVO-S-Bench
radarRecords.title: OVO-S-Bench

radarRecords.name: NovelAPIBench
radarRecords.title: NovelAPIBench

radarRecords.name: MedCUA-Bench
radarRecords.title: MedCUA-Bench
radarRecords.description: MedCUA-Bench is an interactive benchmark for clinical computer-use agents, covering 18 scenarios in 10 medical domains with deterministic safety evaluation.
radarRecords.oneLine: MedCUA-Bench is an interactive benchmark for clinical computer-use agents, covering 18 scenarios in 10 medical domains with deterministic safety evaluation.

radarRecords.name: HighTide

radarRecords.name: Hedge-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: Hedge-Bench 1.0 evaluates agents on 102 financial reasoning tasks with deterministic grading against expert reasoning traces.

radarRecords.name: GTBench
radarRecords.title: GTBench
radarRecords.description: GTBench is a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mathematical research assistants in graph theory, with problems across three difficulty groups.
radarRecords.oneLine: GTBench is a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLMs as mathematical research assistants in graph theory, with problems across three difficulty groups.

radarRecords.name: GroupToM-Bench
radarRecords.title: GroupToM-Bench

radarRecords.name: FinStressTS
radarRecords.title: FinStressTS

radarRecords.oneLine: FinStressTS is a synthetic benchmark for financial time-series forecasting with controllable mechanisms and diagnostic environments.

radarRecords.name: EVID-Bench
radarRecords.title: EVID-Bench

radarRecords.name: EntSQL
radarRecords.title: EntSQL
radarRecords.description: EntSQL evaluates text-to-SQL systems on enterprise knowledge grounding, with 1,066 Chinese-English examples across five business domains requiring private business knowledge. Systems generate SQL from questions and schema, with some provided long-form documents.
radarRecords.oneLine: EntSQL evaluates text-to-SQL systems on enterprise knowledge grounding, with 1,066 Chinese-English examples across five business domains requiring private business knowledge. Systems generate SQL from questions and schema, with some provided long-form documents.

radarRecords.name: eMEM-Bench
radarRecords.title: eMEM-Bench
radarRecords.description: eMEM-Bench v1 evaluates embodied memory systems through 988 probes across eight cognitive-psychology paradigms (DRM lures, pattern separation, pattern completion, source monitoring, context-dependent retrieval, long-horizon interference, serial position, foil retention curve) in ProcTHOR-10K scenes.

radarRecords.name: DOSEBENCH
radarRecords.title: DOSEBENCH
radarRecords.description: DOSEBENCH evaluates LLM decision-making on over-the-counter dosing questions, with 81 curated scenarios for adult acetaminophen and ibuprofen use. Correct answers require tracking dose timing, computing rolling 24-hour intake, and following product-label constraints.
radarRecords.oneLine: DOSEBENCH evaluates LLM decision-making on over-the-counter dosing questions, with 81 curated scenarios for adult acetaminophen and ibuprofen use. Correct answers require tracking dose timing, computing rolling 24-hour intake, and following product-label constraints.

radarRecords.name: DeskCraft
radarRecords.title: DeskCraft

radarRecords.oneLine: DeskCraft evaluates desktop GUI agents on long-horizon professional workflows and human-in-the-loop collaboration across 538 executable tasks in live Ubuntu desktop environments. Covers design, video, audio, and 3D creation software, with execution-based verification.

radarRecords.name: DelegateCI-Bench
radarRecords.title: DelegateCI-Bench
radarRecords.description: DelegateCI-Bench evaluates privacy-conscious query rewriting for LLM delegation, with 3,167 samples combining synthetic data across 20 task types, real user queries from WildChat, and a medical challenge set. radarRecords.oneLine: DelegateCI-Bench evaluates privacy-conscious query rewriting for LLM delegation, with 3,167 samples combining synthetic data across 20 task types, real user queries from WildChat, and a medical challenge set. radarRecords.name: ClinicalMC
radarRecords.title: ClinicalMC
radarRecords.description: ClinicalMC evaluates LLM clinical decision-making across multi-course patient trajectories, with 1,275 Chinese and 5,804 English samples spanning four stages from admission to discharge. Includes triage, examination, diagnosis, treatment, and final diagnosis.
radarRecords.oneLine: ClinicalMC evaluates LLM clinical decision-making across multi-course patient trajectories, with 1,275 Chinese and 5,804 English samples spanning four stages from admission to discharge. Includes triage, examination, diagnosis, treatment, and final diagnosis.

radarRecords.name: ChemCoTBench-V2
radarRecords.title: ChemCoTBench-V2

radarRecords.name: BigFinanceBench

radarRecords.oneLine: BigFinanceBench evaluates financial-research agents on open-ended tasks with 928 items, each paired with a ground-truth answer and a point-weighted rubric decomposing the derivation into steps. Supports partial-credit scoring across 36,241 rubric points.

radarRecords.name: X-Stream
radarRecords.title: X-Stream
radarRecords.description: Evaluates multimodal large language models on multi-stream streaming understanding, with 4,220 QA pairs across 932 videos covering 11 subtasks in multi-window, multi-view, and multi-device scenarios, using a dual-verification construction pipeline and online inference under a fixed average video-token rate.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates multimodal large language models on multi-stream streaming understanding, with 4,220 QA pairs across 932 videos covering 11 subtasks in multi-window, multi-view, and multi-device scenarios, using a dual-verification construction pipeline and online inference under a fixed average video-token rate.

radarRecords.name: WorldCoder-Bench
radarRecords.title: WorldCoder-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates autonomous physically grounded 3D world synthesis from natural language, with 2,026 expert-curated tasks across Simulation, Rendering, and Application scenarios, using execution-based verification via StateProbe to check hidden behavioral contracts over runtime states.

radarRecords.name: The Image Reconstruction Game
radarRecords.title: The Image Reconstruction Game
radarRecords.description: A benchmark for iterative multimodal dialogue where a vision-language model issues corrective instructions to an image generator over multiple turns, with accumulated common ground observable as a rendered image.
radarRecords.oneLine: A benchmark for iterative multimodal dialogue where a vision-language model issues corrective instructions to an image generator over multiple turns, with accumulated common ground observable as a rendered image.

radarRecords.name: TELBench
radarRecords.title: TELBench
radarRecords.description: Evaluates span-level error localization in deep-research agent trajectories. TELBench comprises 1,000 instances with annotations of harmful error spans among normal exploration, failed searches, tentative hypotheses, and harmless noise, scored by span-level localization and first-error accuracy.
radarRecords.oneLine: Evaluates span-level error localization in deep-research agent trajectories. radarRecords.name: SPADE-Bench
radarRecords.title: SPADE-Bench

radarRecords.name: SMH-Bench
radarRecords.title: SMH-Bench

radarRecords.oneLine: Benchmark for LLM agents in smart-home environments, with 1,100 tasks across 7 categories and 22 subcategories, built on the executable HomeEnv simulator, stratified by home complexity.

radarRecords.name: SkillHarm
radarRecords.title: SkillHarm

radarRecords.oneLine: Benchmark of skill-based attacks across the skill-use lifecycle, with 879 attack samples across 71 skills, evaluating Fixed-Payload Poisoning and Self-Mutating Poisoning scenarios across 12 risk types, with attack success rate as primary metric.

radarRecords.name: RotOutBench
radarRecords.title: RotOutBench

radarRecords.oneLine: Paired diagnostic benchmark for rotated-outcome prediction in vision-language models, spanning open visual cases and controlled text-image rotations, with accuracy metrics for direct reading and prediction.

radarRecords.name: RoleCDE
radarRecords.title: RoleCDE
radarRecords.description: RoleCDE evaluates role-playing agents under structured conflicts between role-specific values and alignment-oriented constraints. radarRecords.name: RoboTrustBench
radarRecords.title: RoboTrustBench
radarRecords.description: RoboTrustBench evaluates the trustworthiness of video world models for robotic manipulation across four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. radarRecords.name: RoboSemanticBench
radarRecords.title: RoboSemanticBench
radarRecords.description: RoboSemanticBench (RSB) is an embodied benchmark evaluating whether vision-language-action models use instruction semantics to select and grasp the correct physical target among candidate blocks in response to math or general-knowledge questions. It includes six suites with four- or ten-choice variants, procedural arithmetic, GSM8K-style, and MMLU-style questions, with diagnostic metrics separating task success from grasp success.

radarRecords.name: RescueBench
radarRecords.title: RescueBench
radarRecords.description: RescueBench evaluates embodied search-and-rescue agents in simulated photo-realistic environments. It comprises a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. Five difficulty levels vary environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy. Automatic episode generation and annotation support scalable evaluation. A unified benchmark framework and runner scripts provide standardized scoring.

radarRecords.name: RESCAST-100K
radarRecords.title: RESCAST-100K

It provides ~100,000 EnergyPlus-simulated U.S. homes with 15-minute time series for total load, HVAC load, and indoor temperature, plus weather, setpoints, and static covariates. It includes configurable domain axes and integrates five real-world datasets for sim-to-real evaluation.
radarRecords.oneLine: RESCAST-100K evaluates cross-domain residential load and indoor temperature forecasting. radarRecords.name: Plan2Map
radarRecords.title: Plan2Map

radarRecords.oneLine: Plan2Map evaluates document-grounded geospatial boundary reconstruction from UK planning records. Systems input a planning document and output a GeoJSON boundary, scored against held-out reference boundaries via IoU.

radarRecords.name: PaSBench-Video
radarRecords.title: PaSBench-Video

radarRecords.name: Moment-Video

radarRecords.oneLine: Moment-Video evaluates video MLLMs on momentary visual event understanding through 1,000 human-verified video-QA pairs across four task types: temporal occurrence, temporal counting, action description, and temporal reasoning.

radarRecords.name: MCP-Persona
radarRecords.title: MCP-Persona

radarRecords.name: LL-Bench

radarRecords.name: K-BrowseComp

radarRecords.name: HLL

radarRecords.name: HERO'S JOURNEY
radarRecords.title: HERO'S JOURNEY
